`src/net/net_wire.h`:

```h
// Little-endian serialisation for the network protocol. The reader checks
// every length against what is left, so packets from the network can be
// parsed without trusting them: after a failed read ok() is false and every
// later read returns zeros.

#ifndef OPENCMR2_NET_WIRE_H
#define OPENCMR2_NET_WIRE_H

#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace net {

class Writer {
public:
    void U8(uint8_t v) { data.push_back(v); }
    void U16(uint16_t v)
    {
        U8((uint8_t)v);
        U8((uint8_t)(v >> 8));
    }
    void U32(uint32_t v)
    {
        U16((uint16_t)v);
        U16((uint16_t)(v >> 16));
    }
    void Bytes(const void *p, size_t n)
    {
        const uint8_t *b = (const uint8_t *)p;
        data.insert(data.end(), b, b + n);
    }
    // Length-prefixed (32-bit) blob and string.
    void Blob(const void *p, size_t n)
    {
        U32((uint32_t)n);
        Bytes(p, n);
    }
    void Blob(const std::vector<uint8_t> &v) { Blob(v.data(), v.size()); }
    void Str(const std::string &s) { Blob(s.data(), s.size()); }

    std::vector<uint8_t> data;
};

class Reader {
public:
    Reader(const void *p, size_t n) : p((const uint8_t *)p), left(n) {}

    bool ok() const { return good; }
    bool empty() const { return left == 0; }

    uint8_t U8()
    {
        uint8_t v = 0;
        Take(&v, 1);
        return v;
    }
    uint16_t U16()
    {
        uint8_t b[2] = {};
        Take(b, 2);
        return (uint16_t)(b[0] | b[1] << 8);
    }
    uint32_t U32()
    {
        uint8_t b[4] = {};
        Take(b, 4);
        return (uint32_t)b[0] | (uint32_t)b[1] << 8 | (uint32_t)b[2] << 16 | (uint32_t)b[3] << 24;
    }
    void Bytes(void *out, size_t n)
    {
        if (!Take(out, n))
            memset(out, 0, n);
    }
    // A blob of at most max bytes; longer ones fail the reader.
    std::vector<uint8_t> Blob(size_t max)
    {
        uint32_t n = U32();
        std::vector<uint8_t> v;
        if (!good || n > max || n > left) {
            good = false;
            return v;
        }
        v.assign(p, p + n);
        p += n;
        left -= n;
        return v;
    }
    // A string of at most max bytes, cut at an embedded NUL.
    std::string Str(size_t max)
    {
        std::vector<uint8_t> v = Blob(max);
        std::string s(v.begin(), v.end());
        size_t nul = s.find('\0');
        if (nul != std::string::npos)
            s.resize(nul);
        return s;
    }

private:
    bool Take(void *out, size_t n)
    {
        if (!good || n > left) {
            good = false;
            return false;
        }
        memcpy(out, p, n);
        p += n;
        left -= n;
        return true;
    }

    const uint8_t *p;
    size_t left;
    bool good = true;
};

} // namespace net

#endif
```

```cpp
int Keys_FromScancode(SDL_Scancode scancode)
{
    for (const KeyMapping &key : s_keys)
        if (key.scancode == scancode)
            return key.dik;
    return 0;
}

SDL_Scancode Keys_ToScancode(int dik)
{
    for (const KeyMapping &key : s_keys)
        if (key.dik == dik)
            return key.scancode;
    return SDL_SCANCODE_UNKNOWN;
}

const char *Keys_GetName(int dik)
{
    SDL_Scancode scancode = Keys_ToScancode(dik);
    if (scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_UNKNOWN)
        return "";
    // The key's name in the current keyboard layout ("Y" on a QWERTZ
    // keyboard for the scan code a US layout calls "Z").
    SDL_Keycode keycode = SDL_GetKeyFromScancode(scancode, SDL_KMOD_NONE, false);
    const char *name = SDL_GetKeyName(keycode);
    return name && *name ? name : SDL_GetScancodeName(scancode);
}
```

```cpp
// Process entry point: sets up the platform and runs the game's main loop
// (CMain::Initialize, which was WinMain's body).

#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "port/sys.h"
#include "diagnostics/timing.h"
#include "main.h"

// On Android, SDLActivity calls SDL_main, which SDL_main.h renames main to.
#ifndef __ANDROID__
#define SDL_MAIN_HANDLED
#endif
#include <SDL3/SDL_main.h>

int main(int argc, char **argv)
{
    SDL_SetMainReady();
    if (!Platform_Init(argc, argv))
        return Platform_WasSetupCanceled() ? 0 : 1;
    Diagnostics::StartProfileFromEnvironment();
    unsigned int code = CMain::Initialize(Sys_GetCommandLine());
    Diagnostics::StopProfile();
    Platform_Shutdown();
    return (int)code;
}
```

`src/platform/menu_shortcut.cpp`:

```cpp
// Applications menu entry of an unpacked release: a .desktop file and icon
// under XDG_DATA_HOME on Linux, a Start menu shortcut on Windows. Kept apart
// from sys.cpp because <windows.h> clashes with port/types.h.

#include "platform/platform.h"

#include <filesystem>
#include <string>

#ifdef _WIN32
#include <windows.h>
#include <objbase.h>
#include <shlobj.h>
#include <shobjidl.h>
#elif defined(__linux__) && !defined(__ANDROID__)
#include "opencmr2_icon.h"
#endif

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

#ifdef _WIN32

namespace {

std::wstring ExecutablePath()
{
    std::wstring path(MAX_PATH, L'\0');
    for (;;) {
        DWORD length = GetModuleFileNameW(NULL, path.data(), (DWORD)path.size());
        if (length == 0)
            return std::wstring();
        if (length < path.size()) {
            path.resize(length);
            return path;
        }
        path.resize(path.size() * 2);
    }
}

fs::path ShortcutPath()
{
    PWSTR programs = NULL;
    if (FAILED(SHGetKnownFolderPath(FOLDERID_Programs, 0, NULL, &programs)))
        return fs::path();
    fs::path path = fs::path(programs) / L"OpenCMR2.lnk";
    CoTaskMemFree(programs);
    return path;
}

bool WriteShortcut(const std::wstring &exe, const fs::path &file)
{
    HRESULT init = CoInitializeEx(NULL, COINIT_APARTMENTTHREADED);
    if (FAILED(init) && init != RPC_E_CHANGED_MODE)
        return SDL_SetError("COM is unavailable (0x%08lx)", (unsigned long)init);
    IShellLinkW *link = NULL;
    IPersistFile *persist = NULL;
    HRESULT result = CoCreateInstance(CLSID_ShellLink, NULL, CLSCTX_INPROC_SERVER, IID_IShellLinkW, (void **)&link);
    if (SUCCEEDED(result)) {
        link->SetPath(exe.c_str());
        link->SetWorkingDirectory(fs::path(exe).parent_path().c_str());
        link->SetIconLocation(exe.c_str(), 0);
        link->SetDescription(L"Colin McRae Rally 2.0 (needs the original game files)");
        result = link->QueryInterface(IID_IPersistFile, (void **)&persist);
    }
    if (SUCCEEDED(result))
        result = persist->Save(file.c_str(), TRUE);
    if (persist != NULL)
        persist->Release();
    if (link != NULL)
        link->Release();
    if (SUCCEEDED(init))
        CoUninitialize();
    return SUCCEEDED(result) ? true : SDL_SetError("Cannot create the shortcut (0x%08lx)", (unsigned long)result);
}

} // namespace

bool Shortcut_IsSupported(void)
{
    return true;
}

const char *Shortcut_MenuName(void)
{
    return "the Start menu";
}

bool Shortcut_Update(bool present)
{
    const fs::path file = ShortcutPath();
    if (file.empty())
        return SDL_SetError("The Start menu folder was not found");
    if (!present) {
        std::error_code error;
        fs::remove(file, error);
        return !error || SDL_SetError("%s", error.message().c_str());
    }
    const std::wstring exe = ExecutablePath();
    if (exe.empty())
        return SDL_SetError("The game's own path is unknown");
    return WriteShortcut(exe, file);
}

#elif defined(__linux__) && !defined(__ANDROID__)

namespace {

const char s_appId[] = "io.github.pablocpas.OpenCMR2";

fs::path DataHome()
{
    const char *xdg = SDL_getenv("XDG_DATA_HOME");
    if (xdg != NULL && xdg[0] == '/')
        return fs::u8path(xdg);
    const char *home = SDL_getenv("HOME");
    return home != NULL && home[0] == '/' ? fs::u8path(home) / ".local/share" : fs::path();
}

// The file the menu starts: the AppImage itself when running from one.
std::string ExecutablePath()
{
    const char *appImage = SDL_getenv("APPIMAGE");
    if (appImage != NULL && appImage[0] == '/')
        return appImage;
    std::error_code error;
    fs::path exe = fs::read_symlink("/proc/self/exe", error);
    return error ? std::string() : exe.u8string();
}

// A quoted Exec argument (Desktop Entry Specification, "The Exec key").
std::string ExecArgument(const std::string &path)
{
    std::string out = "\"";
    for (char c : path) {
        if (c == '"' || c == '`' || c == '$')
            out += "\\\\";
        else if (c == '\\')
            out += "\\\\\\";
        else if (c == '%')
            out += '%';
        out += c;
    }
    return out + '"';
}

// A string value: only backslashes need escaping in a path.
std::string StringValue(const std::string &text)
{
    std::string out;
    for (char c : text) {
        if (c == '\\')
            out += '\\';
        out += c;
    }
    return out;
}

// Writes the file unless it already holds these bytes.
bool WriteIfChanged(const fs::path &file, const void *data, size_t size)
{
    size_t oldSize = 0;
    void *old = SDL_LoadFile(file.u8string().c_str(), &oldSize);
    bool same = old != NULL && oldSize == size && SDL_memcmp(old, data, size) == 0;
    SDL_free(old);
    if (same)
        return true;
    std::error_code error;
    fs::create_directories(file.parent_path(), error);
    const std::string temporary = file.u8string() + ".tmp";
    if (!SDL_SaveFile(temporary.c_str(), data, size))
        return false;
    if (!SDL_RenamePath(temporary.c_str(), file.u8string().c_str())) {
        SDL_RemovePath(temporary.c_str());
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

} // namespace

// Flatpak and distribution packages install their own menu entry.
bool Shortcut_IsSupported(void)
{
    if (SDL_getenv("FLATPAK_ID") != NULL || SDL_getenv("SNAP") != NULL ||
        SDL_GetPathInfo("/.flatpak-info", NULL))
        return false;
    const std::string exe = ExecutablePath();
    return !exe.empty() && exe.compare(0, 5, "/usr/") != 0 && !DataHome().empty();
}

const char *Shortcut_MenuName(void)
{
    return "your applications menu";
}

bool Shortcut_Update(bool present)
{
    const fs::path home = DataHome();
    if (home.empty())
        return SDL_SetError("Neither XDG_DATA_HOME nor HOME is set");
    const fs::path desktop = home / "applications" / (std::string(s_appId) + ".desktop");
    const fs::path icon = home / "icons/hicolor/256x256/apps" / (std::string(s_appId) + ".png");
    if (!present) {
        std::error_code error;
        fs::remove(desktop, error);
        fs::remove(icon, error);
        return true;
    }
    const std::string exe = ExecutablePath();
    if (exe.empty())
        return SDL_SetError("The game's own path is unknown");
    const std::string entry = "[Desktop Entry]\n"
                              "Type=Application\n"
                              "Name=OpenCMR2\n"
                              "GenericName=Rally game\n"
                              "Comment=Colin McRae Rally 2.0 (needs the original game files)\n"
                              "Exec=" + ExecArgument(exe) + "\n"
                              // By path: a theme name would depend on the user's
                              // icon cache, which GTK does not refresh for a new file.
                              "Icon=" + StringValue(icon.u8string()) + "\n"
                              "Terminal=false\n"
                              "Categories=Game;SportsGame;\n"
                              "StartupWMClass=" + s_appId + "\n";
    return WriteIfChanged(icon, g_opencmr2_256_png, sizeof(g_opencmr2_256_png)) &&
           WriteIfChanged(desktop, entry.data(), entry.size());
}

#else

// macOS and Android: the app bundle or package is the menu entry.
bool Shortcut_IsSupported(void) { return false; }
const char *Shortcut_MenuName(void) { return ""; }
bool Shortcut_Update(bool) { return true; }

#endif
```

`src/platform/msvcrt.cpp`:

```cpp
// MSVC 6 C runtime behaviour, see port/msvcrt.h.

#include "port/types.h"
#include "port/msvcrt.h"

#include <ctype.h>

static unsigned int s_randSeed = 1;

extern "C" int Crt_Rand(void)
{
    s_randSeed = s_randSeed * 214013u + 2531011u;
    return (int)((s_randSeed >> 16) & 0x7fff);
}

extern "C" void Crt_Srand(unsigned int seed)
{
    s_randSeed = seed;
}

extern "C" unsigned int Crt_GetRandState(void) { return s_randSeed; }

extern "C" char *Crt_Strlwr(char *s)
{
    for (char *p = s; *p; p++)
        *p = (char)tolower((unsigned char)*p);
    return s;
}

extern "C" char *Crt_Strupr(char *s)
{
    for (char *p = s; *p; p++)
        *p = (char)toupper((unsigned char)*p);
    return s;
}

extern "C" char *Crt_Itoa(int value, char *buffer, int radix)
{
    char digits[34];
    int n = 0;
    char *out = buffer;
    // MSVC prints negative values with a sign only in base 10.
    unsigned int v = (radix == 10 && value < 0) ? 0u - (unsigned int)value : (unsigned int)value;

    if (radix == 10 && value < 0)
        *out++ = '-';
    do {
        unsigned int d = v % (unsigned int)radix;
        digits[n++] = (char)(d < 10 ? '0' + d : 'a' + d - 10);
        v /= (unsigned int)radix;
    } while (v != 0);
    while (n > 0)
        *out++ = digits[--n];
    *out = 0;
    return buffer;
}

static void CopyPart(char *dst, size_t size, const char *begin, const char *end)
{
    if (dst == NULL)
        return;
    size_t n = (size_t)(end - begin);
    if (n >= size)
        n = size - 1;
    memcpy(dst, begin, n);
    dst[n] = 0;
}

extern "C" void Crt_SplitPath(const char *path, char *drive, char *dir, char *fname, char *ext)
{
    const char *p = path;
    const char *lastSlash = NULL;
    const char *lastDot = NULL;

    if (p[0] && p[1] == ':') {
        CopyPart(drive, _MAX_DRIVE, p, p + 2);
        p += 2;
    } else if (drive != NULL) {
        drive[0] = 0;
    }
    for (const char *q = p; *q; q++) {
        if (*q == '\\' || *q == '/')
            lastSlash = q;
        else if (*q == '.')
            lastDot = q;
    }
    const char *nameStart = lastSlash ? lastSlash + 1 : p;
    CopyPart(dir, _MAX_DIR, p, nameStart);
    if (lastDot != NULL && lastDot >= nameStart) {
        CopyPart(fname, _MAX_FNAME, nameStart, lastDot);
        CopyPart(ext, _MAX_EXT, lastDot, lastDot + strlen(lastDot));
    } else {
        CopyPart(fname, _MAX_FNAME, nameStart, nameStart + strlen(nameStart));
        if (ext != NULL)
            ext[0] = 0;
    }
}
```

`src/platform/sys.cpp`:

```cpp
// System services on SDL3: see port/sys.h.

#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "platform/testing.h"
#include "port/sys.h"

#include <stdarg.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <time.h>

#include <atomic>
#include <filesystem>
#include <map>
#include <sstream>
#include <set>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#ifndef _WIN32
#include "opencmr2_icon.h"
#endif

namespace {

SDL_Window *s_window;
std::string s_dataDir;     // game data, read only (ends with '/')
std::string s_userDir;     // saves, settings, logs (ends with '/')
std::string s_commandLine;
std::map<std::string, std::string> s_settings;  // "section.key" -> value
FILE *s_logFile;
const PlatformTestClock *s_testClock;
const PlatformTestDialogs *s_testDialogs;
bool s_setupCanceled;

FILE *OpenHostFile(const char *path, const char *mode)
{
#ifdef _WIN32
    // SDL paths and folder dialog results are UTF-8. The Windows narrow CRT
    // uses the system code page, so open them through its Unicode interface.
    wchar_t *widePath = (wchar_t *)SDL_iconv_string("WCHAR_T", "UTF-8", path, strlen(path) + 1);
    wchar_t *wideMode = (wchar_t *)SDL_iconv_string("WCHAR_T", "UTF-8", mode, strlen(mode) + 1);
    FILE *file = widePath && wideMode ? _wfopen(widePath, wideMode) : NULL;
    SDL_free(widePath);
    SDL_free(wideMode);
    return file;
#else
    return fopen(path, mode);
#endif
}

// ---- paths -----------------------------------------------------------------

std::string Lower(const std::string &s)
{
    std::string out = s;
    for (char &c : out)
        c = (char)SDL_tolower((unsigned char)c);
    return out;
}

// Splits a game path into its components: drive letters, "." and empty
// components dropped, ".." applied.
std::vector<std::string> SplitGamePath(const char *path)
{
    std::vector<std::string> parts;
    const char *p = path;

    if (p[0] && p[1] == ':')
        p += 2;
    std::string part;
    for (;; p++) {
        if (*p == '\\' || *p == '/' || *p == 0) {
            if (part == "..") {
                if (!parts.empty())
                    parts.pop_back();
            } else if (!part.empty() && part != ".") {
                parts.push_back(part);
            }
            part.clear();
            if (*p == 0)
                break;
        } else {
            part += *p;
        }
    }
    return parts;
}

// Directory listings, lower-case name -> name on disk.
std::map<std::string, std::map<std::string, std::string>> s_dirCache;

SDL_EnumerationResult SDLCALL CollectDirectoryEntry(void *userdata, const char *, const char *name)
{
    auto &entries = *(std::map<std::string, std::string> *)userdata;
    entries.emplace(Lower(name), name);
    return SDL_ENUM_CONTINUE;
}

const std::map<std::string, std::string> &ListDir(const std::string &dir)
{
    auto it = s_dirCache.find(dir);
    if (it != s_dirCache.end())
        return it->second;

    std::map<std::string, std::string> &entries = s_dirCache[dir];
    // Enumerate direct children only. A glob with no pattern can recurse
    // through the entire tree on some SDL backends, especially drive roots.
    SDL_EnumerateDirectory(dir.c_str(), CollectDirectoryEntry, &entries);
    return entries;
}

// Finds parts under root without regard to case; returns the host path or "".
std::string FindUnder(const std::string &root, const std::vector<std::string> &parts)
{
    std::string path = root;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < parts.size(); i++) {
        const auto &entries = ListDir(path);
        auto it = entries.find(Lower(parts[i]));
        if (it == entries.end())
            return std::string();
        path += it->second;
        if (i + 1 < parts.size())
            path += '/';
    }
    return path;
}

// Host path for writing under the user directory; creates the directories,
// reusing existing ones whatever their case.
std::string PathForWriting(const std::vector<std::string> &parts)
{
    std::string path = s_userDir;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < parts.size(); i++) {
        const auto &entries = ListDir(path);
        auto it = entries.find(Lower(parts[i]));
        std::string name = it != entries.end() ? it->second : parts[i];
        bool isDir = i + 1 < parts.size();
        if (it == entries.end()) {
            if (isDir)
                SDL_CreateDirectory((path + name).c_str());
            s_dirCache[path].emplace(Lower(name), name);
        }
        path += name;
        if (isDir)
            path += '/';
    }
    return path;
}

std::string ResolveForReading(const char *gamePath)
{
    std::vector<std::string> parts = SplitGamePath(gamePath);
    if (parts.empty())
        return std::string();
    std::string found = FindUnder(s_userDir, parts);
    if (found.empty())
        found = FindUnder(s_dataDir, parts);
    return found;
}

bool MatchPattern(const std::string &name, const std::string &pattern)
{
    // One '*' at most, compared without regard to case ("*.sav").
    std::string n = Lower(name), p = Lower(pattern);
    size_t star = p.find('*');
    if (star == std::string::npos)
        return n == p;
    std::string head = p.substr(0, star), tail = p.substr(star + 1);
    return n.size() >= head.size() + tail.size() && n.compare(0, head.size(), head) == 0 &&
           n.compare(n.size() - tail.size(), tail.size(), tail) == 0;
}

// ---- settings ----------------------------------------------------------------

void LoadSettings(const std::string &file)
{
    char *contents = (char *)SDL_LoadFile(file.c_str(), NULL);
    if (contents == NULL)
        return;
    std::istringstream input(contents);
    SDL_free(contents);
    std::string line;
    std::string section;
    while (std::getline(input, line)) {
        std::string s = line;
        while (!s.empty() && (s.back() == '\n' || s.back() == '\r' || s.back() == ' '))
            s.pop_back();
        size_t start = s.find_first_not_of(" \t");
        if (start == std::string::npos || s[start] == ';' || s[start] == '#')
            continue;
        s = s.substr(start);
        if (s[0] == '[') {
            section = Lower(s.substr(1, s.find(']') - 1));
            continue;
        }
        size_t eq = s.find('=');
        if (eq == std::string::npos)
            continue;
        std::string key = s.substr(0, eq), value = s.substr(eq + 1);
        while (!key.empty() && key.back() == ' ')
            key.pop_back();
        value.erase(0, value.find_first_not_of(' '));
        s_settings[section + "." + Lower(key)] = value;
    }
}

// Sets "key = value" in [section] of the settings file: the first such line
// is replaced in place and repeats (in any [section] block) are dropped.
// Unrelated settings and comments are kept; SDL's UTF-8 paths work on Windows too.
bool SaveSetting(const std::string &file, const std::string &section, const std::string &key,
                 const std::string &value)
{
    if (value.find_first_of("\r\n") != std::string::npos)
        return SDL_SetError("The value contains a line break");
    char *contents = (char *)SDL_LoadFile(file.c_str(), NULL);
    if (!contents)
        return false;
    std::istringstream input(contents);
    SDL_free(contents);
    const std::string setting = key + " = " + value;
    std::vector<std::string> lines;
    std::string line, current;
    size_t headerEnd = std::string::npos;
    bool written = false;
    while (std::getline(input, line)) {
        if (!line.empty() && line.back() == '\r')
            line.pop_back();
        size_t start = line.find_first_not_of(" \t");
        std::string text = start == std::string::npos ? "" : line.substr(start);
        if (!text.empty() && text[0] == '[') {
            current = Lower(text.substr(1, text.find(']') - 1));
            lines.push_back(line);
            if (current == section && headerEnd == std::string::npos)
                headerEnd = lines.size();
            continue;
        }
        size_t eq = text.find('=');
        if (current == section && eq != std::string::npos) {
            std::string name = text.substr(0, eq);
            size_t end = name.find_last_not_of(" \t");
            if (end != std::string::npos && Lower(name.substr(0, end + 1)) == key) {
                if (!written)
                    lines.push_back(setting);
                written = true;
                continue;
            }
        }
        lines.push_back(line);
    }
    if (!written && headerEnd != std::string::npos)
        lines.insert(lines.begin() + headerEnd, setting);
    else if (!written)
        lines.insert(lines.end(), {"", "[" + section + "]", setting});
    std::string output;
    for (const std::string &l : lines)
        output += l + '\n';
    const std::string temporary = file + ".tmp";
    if (!SDL_SaveFile(temporary.c_str(), output.data(), output.size()))
        return false;
    if (!SDL_RenamePath(temporary.c_str(), file.c_str())) {
        std::string error = SDL_GetError();
        SDL_RemovePath(temporary.c_str());
        return SDL_SetError("%s", error.c_str());
    }
    s_settings[section + "." + key] = value;
    return true;
}

bool SaveDataSetting(const std::string &file, const std::string &dir)
{
    if (dir.find_first_of("\r\n") != std::string::npos)
        return SDL_SetError("The folder name contains a line break");
    return SaveSetting(file, "paths", "data", dir);
}

std::string MissingGameData(const std::string &dir)
{
    std::string missing;
    // These archives are common to the PC editions; folder names alone also
    // match empty directories and unextracted installer media.
    for (const char *file : {"Game/Bigfiles/common.bfl", "FrontEnd/common.bfl", "Sounds/surface.bfl"}) {
        std::string path = FindUnder(dir, SplitGamePath(file));
        SDL_PathInfo info{};
        if (path.empty() || !SDL_GetPathInfo(path.c_str(), &info) ||
            info.type != SDL_PATHTYPE_FILE || info.size == 0)
            missing += std::string("\n- ") + file;
    }
    return missing;
}

std::string WithSlash(std::string dir)
{
    if (!dir.empty() && dir.back() != '/')
        dir += '/';
    return dir;
}

std::vector<std::string> FindNearbyGameData(const std::string &selected)
{
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    std::error_code error;
    fs::path start = fs::absolute(fs::u8path(selected), error).lexically_normal();
    if (error)
        return {};
    // Resolve links when encountered, keeping ordinary paths inexpensive and
    // preserving their spelling (e.g. macOS's /var alias for /private/var).
    if (fs::is_symlink(start, error)) {
        start = fs::weakly_canonical(start, error);
        if (error)
            return {};
    }
    // Selecting GAME, FRONTEND, or a track deep inside the installation should
    // work too. Prefer the selected folder or its closest valid ancestor.
    for (fs::path parent = start; !parent.empty(); parent = parent.parent_path()) {
        std::string dir = WithSlash(parent.u8string());
        if (MissingGameData(dir).empty())
            return {dir};
        if (parent == parent.parent_path())
            break;
    }

    // A download/collection folder often wraps the installation in a few
    // extra directories. Search locally, with a bound on depth and work; do
    // not descend into a found installation or repeatedly follow symlinks.
    std::vector<std::pair<fs::path, int>> pending{{start, 0}};
    std::set<fs::path> visited{start};
    std::vector<std::string> found;
    for (size_t index = 0; index < pending.size() && index < 512; ++index) {
        const auto current = pending[index];
        std::string dir = WithSlash(current.first.u8string());
        if (index != 0 && MissingGameData(dir).empty()) {
            found.push_back(dir);
            continue;
        }
        if (current.second == 3)
            continue;
        for (const auto &entry : ListDir(dir)) {
            if (pending.size() >= 512)
                break;
            if (entry.second.empty() || entry.second[0] == '.')
                continue;
            std::string child = dir + entry.second;
            SDL_PathInfo info{};
            if (!SDL_GetPathInfo(child.c_str(), &info) || info.type != SDL_PATHTYPE_DIRECTORY)
                continue;
            fs::path childPath = fs::u8path(child).lexically_normal();
            if (fs::is_symlink(childPath, error)) {
                childPath = fs::weakly_canonical(childPath, error);
                if (error)
                    continue;
            }
            if (visited.insert(childPath).second)
                pending.emplace_back(childPath, current.second + 1);
        }
    }
    return found;
}

bool AskForGameFolder(const std::string &message, bool warning = false)
{
    const SDL_MessageBoxButtonData buttons[] = {
        {SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_ESCAPEKEY_DEFAULT, 0, "Exit"},
        {SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_RETURNKEY_DEFAULT, 1, "Select folder"}
    };
    SDL_MessageBoxData box{};
    box.flags = warning ? SDL_MESSAGEBOX_WARNING : SDL_MESSAGEBOX_INFORMATION;
    box.title = "OpenCMR2 - Game setup";
    box.message = message.c_str();
    box.numbuttons = 2;
    box.buttons = buttons;
    int choice = 0;
    bool shown = s_testDialogs ? s_testDialogs->messageBox(&box, &choice) : SDL_ShowMessageBox(&box, &choice);
    if (shown && choice != 1)
        s_setupCanceled = true;
    return shown && choice == 1;
}

struct FolderSelection {
    std::atomic<bool> done{false};
    std::string path, error;
};

void SDLCALL FolderSelected(void *userdata, const char *const *files, int)
{
    auto &selection = *(FolderSelection *)userdata;
    if (!files) {
        selection.error = SDL_GetError();
        if (selection.error.empty())
            selection.error = "The folder selector is unavailable.";
    } else if (*files)
        selection.path = *files; // SDL frees the list after this callback.
    selection.done.store(true, std::memory_order_release);
}

bool SelectGameData(const std::string &settingsFile)
{
    std::string message = "Welcome to OpenCMR2\n\n"
                          "Choose a folder containing your Colin McRae Rally 2.0 copy for PC.\n"
                          "You can also choose a folder inside the installation.\n\n"
                          "Your files stay in place. You only need to choose this folder once.";
    bool warning = false;
    while (AskForGameFolder(message, warning)) {
        FolderSelection selection;
        if (s_testDialogs)
            s_testDialogs->openFolder(FolderSelected, &selection);
        else
            SDL_ShowOpenFolderDialog(FolderSelected, &selection, NULL, NULL, false);
        // Linux portals need events even though the game window is not open yet.
        // The callback can run on another thread; publish its strings atomically.
        while (!selection.done.load(std::memory_order_acquire)) {
            SDL_PumpEvents();
            SDL_Delay(10);
        }
        if (!selection.error.empty()) {
            message = "The folder selector could not be opened.\n\n" + selection.error +
                      "\n\nYou can also set data = <folder> under [paths] in:\n" + settingsFile;
            Sys_Log("%s", message.c_str());
            warning = true;
            continue;
        }
        if (selection.path.empty()) {
            s_setupCanceled = true;
            return false; // Cancel is a normal exit, with no extra error box.
        }
        s_dirCache.clear(); // Allow retry after the user copies missing files.
        std::vector<std::string> matches = FindNearbyGameData(selection.path);
        if (matches.size() > 1) {
            message = "More than one game installation was found in this folder:\n";
            for (size_t i = 0; i < matches.size() && i < 4; ++i)
                message += "\n- " + matches[i];
            message += "\n\nSelect the installation you want to use, or a folder inside it.";
            warning = true;
            continue;
        }
        if (matches.empty()) {
            message = "No complete game installation was found in or near this folder.\n"
                      "Required files missing from the selected folder:" + MissingGameData(WithSlash(selection.path)) +
                      "\n\nSelect the folder of a complete PC installation.\n"
                      "Files on a CD or ISO may need to be installed or extracted first.";
            warning = true;
            continue;
        }
        const std::string &dir = matches.front();
        if (!SaveDataSetting(settingsFile, dir)) {
            message = "The game folder is valid, but its location could not be saved.\n\n" +
                      std::string(SDL_GetError()) + "\n\nCheck that this settings file is writable:\n" + settingsFile;
            Sys_Log("%s", message.c_str());
            warning = true;
            continue;
        }
        s_dataDir = dir;
        return true;
    }
    return false;
}

// Earlier versions kept the user files one level deeper, in OpenCMR2/OpenCMR2
// (~/.local/share/OpenCMR2/OpenCMR2/, %APPDATA%\OpenCMR2\OpenCMR2\). Moves
// them up to userDir once, while it has no settings of its own.
void MoveOldUserDir(const std::string &userDir)
{
    namespace fs = std::filesystem;
    std::error_code error;
    const fs::path dir = fs::u8path(userDir);
    const fs::path old = dir / "OpenCMR2";
    if (fs::exists(dir / "opencmr2.ini", error) || !fs::is_directory(old, error))
        return;
    std::vector<fs::path> entries;
    for (const fs::directory_entry &entry : fs::directory_iterator(old, error))
        entries.push_back(entry.path());
    for (const fs::path &entry : entries) {
        const fs::path target = dir / entry.filename();
        if (fs::exists(target, error))
            continue;
        fs::rename(entry, target, error);
        if (error)
            fprintf(stderr, "Cannot move %s: %s\n", entry.u8string().c_str(), error.message().c_str());
    }
    fs::remove(old, error);   // only when everything was moved
}

// [install] menu_shortcut: unset asks once, 1 keeps the menu entry pointing at
// the copy that runs (it follows the game folder when that moves), 0 removes it.
void UpdateMenuShortcut(const std::string &settingsFile)
{
    if (!Shortcut_IsSupported())
        return;
    const char *setting = Platform_GetSetting("install.menu_shortcut", NULL);
    if (setting == NULL) {
        const std::string message = std::string("Add OpenCMR2 to ") + Shortcut_MenuName() +
            "?\n\nYou can then start the game from there like your other programs."
            "\n\nTo remove it later, set menu_shortcut = 0 in:\n" + settingsFile;
        const SDL_MessageBoxButtonData buttons[] = {
            {SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_ESCAPEKEY_DEFAULT, 0, "No"},
            {SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_RETURNKEY_DEFAULT, 1, "Add"}
        };
        SDL_MessageBoxData box{};
        box.flags = SDL_MESSAGEBOX_INFORMATION;
        box.title = "OpenCMR2";
        box.message = message.c_str();
        box.numbuttons = 2;
        box.buttons = buttons;
        int choice = 0;
        // Without a dialog (no display), ask on a later launch.
        if (!(s_testDialogs ? s_testDialogs->messageBox(&box, &choice) : SDL_ShowMessageBox(&box, &choice)))
            return;
        if (!SaveSetting(settingsFile, "install", "menu_shortcut", choice == 1 ? "1" : "0"))
            Sys_Log("could not save install.menu_shortcut: %s", SDL_GetError());
        s_settings["install.menu_shortcut"] = choice == 1 ? "1" : "0";
        if (choice == 1 && !Shortcut_Update(true)) {
            const std::string error = std::string("OpenCMR2 could not be added to ") + Shortcut_MenuName() +
                                      ".\n\n" + SDL_GetError();
            Sys_Log("%s", error.c_str());
            SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_WARNING, "OpenCMR2", error.c_str(), NULL);
        }
        return;
    }
    if (!Shortcut_Update(Platform_GetSettingInt("install.menu_shortcut", 0) != 0))
        Sys_Log("menu entry: %s", SDL_GetError());
}

} // namespace

// ---- platform lifecycle ------------------------------------------------------

bool Platform_Init(int argc, char **argv)
{
    s_dataDir.clear();
    s_commandLine.clear();
    s_settings.clear();
    s_dirCache.clear();
    s_setupCanceled = false;
    // The identifier names the window for the desktop (the Wayland app ID,
    // matching a future .desktop file) and the game's audio streams.
    SDL_SetAppMetadata("OpenCMR2", NULL, "io.github.pablocpas.OpenCMR2");
#ifdef __ANDROID__
    // The game keeps text input on for its whole run, which on a phone would
    // keep the on-screen keyboard open. Back is the game's Escape (GameActivity).
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_ENABLE_SCREEN_KEYBOARD, "0");
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_ORIENTATIONS, "LandscapeLeft LandscapeRight");
#endif
    if (!SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO | SDL_INIT_EVENTS)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "SDL_Init failed: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
        return false;
    }

    std::string userDir;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "--user-dir") == 0 && i + 1 < argc)
            userDir = argv[++i];
    }
    if (!userDir.empty()) {
        s_userDir = WithSlash(userDir);
        if (!SDL_CreateDirectory(s_userDir.c_str())) {
            fprintf(stderr, "Cannot create user directory: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
            return false;
        }
    } else {
        char *pref = SDL_GetPrefPath("", "OpenCMR2");
        s_userDir = pref ? pref : "./";
        SDL_free(pref);
        if (pref != NULL)
            MoveOldUserDir(s_userDir);
    }
    s_logFile = OpenHostFile((s_userDir + "opencmr2.log").c_str(), "w");

    std::string settingsFile = s_userDir + "opencmr2.ini";
    if (!SDL_GetPathInfo(settingsFile.c_str(), NULL)) {
        SDL_SaveFile(settingsFile.c_str(), s_defaultSettings, sizeof(s_defaultSettings) - 1);
    }
    LoadSettings(settingsFile);

    std::string dataDir;
    for (int i = 1; i < argc; i++) {
        if (strcmp(argv[i], "--data") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            dataDir = argv[++i];
        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], "--user-dir") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {
            ++i;
        } else {
            if (!s_commandLine.empty())
                s_commandLine += ' ';
            s_commandLine += argv[i];
        }
    }

    std::vector<std::string> candidates;
    if (!dataDir.empty()) {
        const std::string missing = MissingGameData(WithSlash(dataDir));
        if (!missing.empty()) {
            const std::string message = "Missing required game files in " + dataDir + ":" + missing;
            fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", message.c_str());
            Sys_Log("%s", message.c_str());
            Platform_Shutdown();
            return false;
        }
        candidates.push_back(dataDir);
    }
    if (const char *env = SDL_getenv("OPENCMR2_DATA"))
        candidates.push_back(env);
    // A Data folder beside the executable stays usable if the folder moves to
    // another PC, even when its settings remember an installation on the old one.
    candidates.push_back("./Data");
    if (const char *base = SDL_GetBasePath())
        candidates.push_back(std::string(base) + "Data");
    if (const char *setting = Platform_GetSetting("paths.data", NULL))
        candidates.push_back(setting);
    candidates.push_back(".");
    if (const char *base = SDL_GetBasePath())
        candidates.push_back(base);

    for (const std::string &candidate : candidates) {
        if (candidate.empty())
            continue;
        std::string dir = WithSlash(candidate);
        if (MissingGameData(dir).empty()) {
            s_dataDir = dir;
            break;
        }
    }
    if (s_dataDir.empty() && !SelectGameData(settingsFile)) {
        Platform_Shutdown();
        return false;
    }
    Sys_Log("game data: %s", s_dataDir.c_str());
    Sys_Log("user directory: %s", s_userDir.c_str());
    // Only for the player's own settings: tools and tests use --user-dir.
    const char *headless = SDL_getenv("OPENCMR2_HEADLESS");
    if (userDir.empty() && (headless == NULL || *headless == '0'))
        UpdateMenuShortcut(settingsFile);
    return true;
}

void Platform_Shutdown(void)
{
    Sys_DestroyWindow();
    if (s_logFile != NULL) {
        fclose(s_logFile);
        s_logFile = NULL;
    }
    SDL_Quit();
}

SDL_Window *Platform_GetWindow(void)
{
    return s_window;
}

bool Platform_WasSetupCanceled(void) { return s_setupCanceled; }

const char *Platform_GetDataDir(void)
{
    return s_dataDir.c_str();
}

const char *Platform_GetUserDir(void)
{
    return s_userDir.c_str();
}

const char *Platform_GetSetting(const char *key, const char *fallback)
{
    auto it = s_settings.find(Lower(key));
    return it != s_settings.end() ? it->second.c_str() : fallback;
}

int Platform_GetSettingInt(const char *key, int fallback)
{
    const char *value = Platform_GetSetting(key, NULL);
    return value != NULL ? (int)strtol(value, NULL, 0) : fallback;
}

// ---- time ----------------------------------------------------------------------

extern "C" DWORD Sys_GetTicks(void)
{
    if (s_testClock)
        return s_testClock->ticks();
    return (DWORD)SDL_GetTicks();
}

extern "C" unsigned int Sys_GetUnixTime(void)
{
    return s_testClock ? s_testClock->unixTime : (unsigned int)time(NULL);
}

void Platform_SetTestClock(const PlatformTestClock *clock) { s_testClock = clock; }
void Platform_SetTestDialogs(const PlatformTestDialogs *dialogs) { s_testDialogs = dialogs; }

extern "C" void Sys_Sleep(DWORD ms)
{
    if (s_testClock) {
        s_testClock->sleep(ms);
        return;
    }
    SDL_Delay(ms);
}

// ---- events ----------------------------------------------------------------------

namespace {

// Windows-1252 code of a Unicode code point, or 0.
int ToWindows1252(Uint32 cp)
{
    static const Uint16 high[32] = { 0x20ac, 0, 0x201a, 0x0192, 0x201e, 0x2026, 0x2020, 0x2021,
                                     0x02c6, 0x2030, 0x0160, 0x2039, 0x0152, 0, 0x017d, 0,
                                     0, 0x2018, 0x2019, 0x201c, 0x201d, 0x2022, 0x2013, 0x2014,
                                     0x02dc, 0x2122, 0x0161, 0x203a, 0x0153, 0, 0x017e, 0x0178 };
    if (cp < 0x80 || (cp >= 0xa0 && cp <= 0xff))
        return (int)cp;
    for (int i = 0; i < 32; i++)
        if (high[i] == cp)
            return 0x80 + i;
    return 0;
}

// Text input can carry several characters; they are handed out one by one.
std::vector<int> s_pendingText;

bool RunInBackground()
{
    return Platform_GetSettingInt("video.run_in_background", 0) != 0;
}

bool Translate(const SDL_Event &e, SysEvent *out)
{
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(*out));
    switch (e.type) {
    case SDL_EVENT_QUIT:
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_CLOSE_REQUESTED:
        out->type = SYS_EVENT_QUIT;
        return true;
    // The game pauses when its window loses the focus or is minimised, as
    // the original did; video.run_in_background keeps it running (network
    // play, two copies on one machine).
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FOCUS_LOST:
        out->type = SYS_EVENT_FOCUS_LOST;
        return !RunInBackground();
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_FOCUS_GAINED:
        out->type = SYS_EVENT_FOCUS_GAINED;
        return !RunInBackground();
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_MINIMIZED:
        out->type = SYS_EVENT_MINIMIZED;
        return !RunInBackground();
    case SDL_EVENT_WINDOW_RESTORED:
        out->type = SYS_EVENT_RESTORED;
        return !RunInBackground();
    case SDL_EVENT_KEY_DOWN:
        // Alt+Enter switches between fullscreen and a window. The game reads
        // the keyboard state too, so Enter is hidden from it until released
        // (it would also confirm the menu entry).
        if ((e.key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_RETURN || e.key.scancode == SDL_SCANCODE_KP_ENTER) &&
            (e.key.mod & SDL_KMOD_ALT) != 0) {
            Input_HoldBackKey(e.key.scancode);
            out->type = SYS_EVENT_TOGGLE_FULLSCREEN;
            return !e.key.repeat;
        }
        out->type = SYS_EVENT_KEY_DOWN;
        out->key = Keys_FromScancode(e.key.scancode);
        out->repeat = e.key.repeat;
        return out->key != 0;
    case SDL_EVENT_TEXT_INPUT: {
        const char *text = e.text.text;
        Uint32 cp;
        while ((cp = SDL_StepUTF8(&text, NULL)) != 0) {
            int c = ToWindows1252(cp);
            if (c != 0)
                s_pendingText.push_back(c);
        }
        return false;
    }
    default:
        return false;
    }
}

bool TakePendingText(SysEvent *out)
{
    if (s_pendingText.empty())
        return false;
    memset(out, 0, sizeof(*out));
    out->type = SYS_EVENT_TEXT;
    out->character = s_pendingText.front();
    s_pendingText.erase(s_pendingText.begin());
    return true;
}

} // namespace

extern "C" int Sys_PollEvent(SysEvent *event)
{
    SDL_Event e;
    if (TakePendingText(event))
        return 1;
    while (SDL_PollEvent(&e)) {
        if (Translate(e, event))
            return 1;
        if (TakePendingText(event))
            return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

extern "C" int Sys_WaitEvent(SysEvent *event)
{
    SDL_Event e;
    if (TakePendingText(event))
        return 1;
    while (SDL_WaitEvent(&e)) {
        if (Translate(e, event))
            return 1;
        if (TakePendingText(event))
            return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

// ---- window ----------------------------------------------------------------------

extern "C" BOOL Sys_CreateWindow(const char *title, BOOL fullscreen)
{
    if (s_window != NULL)
        return TRUE;
    // The renderer sizes the window once it knows the resolution.
    SDL_WindowFlags flags = SDL_WINDOW_HIDDEN | SDL_WINDOW_HIGH_PIXEL_DENSITY;
    if (fullscreen)
        flags |= SDL_WINDOW_FULLSCREEN;
    s_window = SDL_CreateWindow(title, 640, 480, flags);
    if (s_window == NULL) {
        Sys_Log("SDL_CreateWindow failed: %s", SDL_GetError());
        return FALSE;
    }
#ifndef _WIN32
    // On Windows, SDL takes the icon from the executable's resources.
    SDL_Surface *icon = SDL_LoadBMP_IO(SDL_IOFromConstMem(g_opencmr2_icon_bmp, sizeof(g_opencmr2_icon_bmp)), true);
    if (icon != NULL) {
        SDL_SetWindowIcon(s_window, icon);
        SDL_DestroySurface(icon);
    }
#endif
    SDL_StartTextInput(s_window);
    return TRUE;
}

extern "C" void Sys_DestroyWindow(void)
{
    if (s_window != NULL) {
        SDL_DestroyWindow(s_window);
        s_window = NULL;
    }
}

extern "C" void Sys_ShowCursor(BOOL show)
{
    if (show)
        SDL_ShowCursor();
    else
        SDL_HideCursor();
}

extern "C" void Sys_GetDesktopSize(int *width, int *height)
{
    SDL_DisplayID display = s_window ? SDL_GetDisplayForWindow(s_window) : SDL_GetPrimaryDisplay();
    const SDL_DisplayMode *mode = SDL_GetDesktopDisplayMode(display);
    *width = mode ? mode->w : 640;
    *height = mode ? mode->h : 480;
}

// ---- messages ----------------------------------------------------------------------

extern "C" int Sys_MessageBox(const char *title, const char *text, int buttons)
{
    SDL_MessageBoxButtonData okButtons[] = {
        { SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_RETURNKEY_DEFAULT | SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_ESCAPEKEY_DEFAULT,
          SYS_MESSAGEBOX_RESULT_OK, "OK" },
    };
    SDL_MessageBoxButtonData retryButtons[] = {
        { SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_RETURNKEY_DEFAULT, SYS_MESSAGEBOX_RESULT_RETRY, "Retry" },
        { SDL_MESSAGEBOX_BUTTON_ESCAPEKEY_DEFAULT, SYS_MESSAGEBOX_RESULT_CANCEL, "Cancel" },
    };
    SDL_MessageBoxData data = {};
    data.flags = SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR;
    data.window = s_window;
    data.title = title;
    data.message = text;
    if (buttons == SYS_MESSAGEBOX_RETRY_CANCEL) {
        data.numbuttons = 2;
        data.buttons = retryButtons;
    } else {
        data.numbuttons = 1;
        data.buttons = okButtons;
    }
    int result = SYS_MESSAGEBOX_RESULT_CANCEL;
    if (!SDL_ShowMessageBox(&data, &result))
        Sys_Log("message box \"%s\": %s", title, text);
    return result;
}

extern "C" void Sys_Log(const char *format, ...)
{
    char line[1024];
    va_list args;
    va_start(args, format);
    vsnprintf(line, sizeof(line), format, args);
    va_end(args);
#ifdef __ANDROID__
    SDL_Log("%s", line);   // logcat: Android apps have no stderr
#else
    fprintf(stderr, "%s\n", line);
#endif
    if (s_logFile != NULL) {
        fprintf(s_logFile, "%s\n", line);
        fflush(s_logFile);
    }
}

extern "C" void Sys_Fatal(const char *format, ...)
{
    char line[1024];
    va_list args;
    va_start(args, format);
    vsnprintf(line, sizeof(line), format, args);
    va_end(args);
    Sys_Log("fatal: %s", line);
    SDL_ShowSimpleMessageBox(SDL_MESSAGEBOX_ERROR, "OpenCMR2", line, s_window);
    exit(1);
}

extern "C" void Sys_Exit(int code)
{
    Platform_Shutdown();
    exit(code);
}

extern "C" const char *Sys_GetCommandLine(void)
{
    return s_commandLine.c_str();
}

// ---- files ----------------------------------------------------------------------

struct SysFile {
    FILE *f;
};

extern "C" BOOL Sys_ResolvePath(const char *path, BOOL forWriting, char *out, size_t outSize)
{
    std::string host;
    if (forWriting) {
        std::vector<std::string> parts = SplitGamePath(path);
        if (parts.empty())
            return FALSE;
        host = PathForWriting(parts);
    } else {
        host = ResolveForReading(path);
        if (host.empty())
            return FALSE;
    }
    if (host.size() + 1 > outSize)
        return FALSE;
    memcpy(out, host.c_str(), host.size() + 1);
    return TRUE;
}

extern "C" SysFile *Sys_OpenFile(const char *path, int mode)
{
    char host[1024];
    if (!Sys_ResolvePath(path, mode == SYS_FILE_WRITE, host, sizeof(host)))
        return NULL;
    FILE *f = OpenHostFile(host, mode == SYS_FILE_WRITE ? "wb" : "rb");
    if (f == NULL)
        return NULL;
    SysFile *file = new SysFile;
    file->f = f;
    return file;
}

extern "C" void Sys_CloseFile(SysFile *file)
{
    if (file != NULL) {
        fclose(file->f);
        delete file;
    }
}

extern "C" DWORD Sys_ReadFile(SysFile *file, void *buffer, DWORD size)
{
    return (DWORD)fread(buffer, 1, size, file->f);
}

extern "C" DWORD Sys_WriteFile(SysFile *file, const void *buffer, DWORD size)
{
    return (DWORD)fwrite(buffer, 1, size, file->f);
}

extern "C" DWORD Sys_SeekFile(SysFile *file, LONG offset, int origin)
{
    int whence = origin == SYS_SEEK_CUR ? SEEK_CUR : origin == SYS_SEEK_END ? SEEK_END : SEEK_SET;
    if (fseek(file->f, offset, whence) != 0)
        return 0xffffffff;
    return (DWORD)ftell(file->f);
}

extern "C" DWORD Sys_GetFileSize(SysFile *file)
{
    long position = ftell(file->f);
    if (position < 0 || fseek(file->f, 0, SEEK_END) != 0)
        return 0xffffffff;
    long size = ftell(file->f);
    fseek(file->f, position, SEEK_SET);
    return size < 0 ? 0xffffffff : (DWORD)size;
}

extern "C" void Sys_FlushFile(SysFile *file)
{
    fflush(file->f);
}

extern "C" BOOL Sys_FileExists(const char *path)
{
    return !ResolveForReading(path).empty();
}

extern "C" BOOL Sys_DeleteFile(const char *path)
{
    // Only files in the user directory can be deleted.
    std::string host = FindUnder(s_userDir, SplitGamePath(path));
    if (host.empty() || !SDL_RemovePath(host.c_str()))
        return FALSE;
    s_dirCache.clear();
    return TRUE;
}

extern "C" void Sys_ListFiles(const char *directory, const char *pattern, SysListCallback callback, void *context)
{
    std::vector<std::string> parts = SplitGamePath(directory);
    std::map<std::string, std::string> names;
    for (const std::string *root : { &s_dataDir, &s_userDir }) {
        std::string dir = parts.empty() ? *root : FindUnder(*root, parts);
        if (dir.empty())
            continue;
        dir = WithSlash(dir);
        for (const auto &entry : ListDir(dir)) {
            SDL_PathInfo info;
            if (MatchPattern(entry.second, pattern) && SDL_GetPathInfo((dir + entry.second).c_str(), &info) &&
                info.type == SDL_PATHTYPE_FILE)
                names[entry.first] = entry.second;   // the user directory's copy wins
        }
    }
    for (const auto &name : names)
        if (!callback(name.second.c_str(), context))
            break;
}

// ---- settings ----------------------------------------------------------------------

extern "C" const char *Sys_GetInstallSetting(const char *name)
{
    if (SDL_strcasecmp(name, "Game_HDPath") == 0 || SDL_strcasecmp(name, "Game_CDPath") == 0)
        return ".";
    if (SDL_strcasecmp(name, "Install_Version") == 0)
        return "Full";
    if (SDL_strcasecmp(name, "Language") == 0)
        return Platform_GetSetting("install.language", "English");
    if (SDL_strcasecmp(name, "Sku_Type") == 0)
        return Platform_GetSetting("install.sku", "EUROPE");
    return "";
}

extern "C" int Sys_GetOption(const char *name, int fallback)
{
    return Platform_GetSettingInt(name, fallback);
}

extern "C" BOOL Sys_SetOption(const char *name, int value)
{
    std::string key = Lower(name);
    size_t dot = key.find('.');
    if (dot == std::string::npos)
        return FALSE;
    std::string text = std::to_string(value);
    if (!SaveSetting(s_userDir + "opencmr2.ini", key.substr(0, dot), key.substr(dot + 1), text)) {
        Sys_Log("could not save %s = %s: %s", name, text.c_str(), SDL_GetError());
        s_settings[key] = text;
        return FALSE;
    }
    return TRUE;
}
```

`src/port/audio.h`:

```h
/*
 * OpenCMR2 audio interface, implemented in src/audio (one SDL3 audio stream
 * fed by our mixer).
 *
 * The game was written against DirectSound buffers and keeps that model:
 * buffers of PCM data that play (once or looping) at their own frequency,
 * volume and pan; duplicates that share a buffer's data; ring buffers that
 * are refilled behind the play cursor (the streamed music). Volume and pan
 * are in hundredths of a decibel, as in DirectSound.
 */
#ifndef OPENCMR2_PORT_AUDIO_H
#define OPENCMR2_PORT_AUDIO_H

#include "port/types.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct AudioBuffer AudioBuffer;
typedef struct AudioStream AudioStream;

#define AUDIO_VOLUME_MAX 0
#define AUDIO_VOLUME_MIN (-10000)
#define AUDIO_PAN_LEFT (-10000)
#define AUDIO_PAN_CENTER 0
#define AUDIO_PAN_RIGHT 10000

/* Opens the output device. channels is 1 or 2. */
BOOL Audio_Init(int sampleRate, int channels);
void Audio_Shutdown(void);

/* A buffer of 8- or 16-bit PCM. */
AudioBuffer *Audio_CreateBuffer(DWORD sampleRate, int bits, int channels, DWORD bytes);
/* A new buffer that plays the same data with its own position and settings. */
AudioBuffer *Audio_DuplicateBuffer(AudioBuffer *source);
/* Stops and frees the buffer; the data goes with its last user. */
void Audio_ReleaseBuffer(AudioBuffer *buffer);

DWORD Audio_GetBufferSize(AudioBuffer *buffer);
void Audio_GetBufferFormat(AudioBuffer *buffer, DWORD *sampleRate, int *bits, int *channels);

/* Gives access to bytes [offset, offset + bytes) of the buffer, wrapping at
   its end: the first part in (*p1, *n1), the wrapped part in (*p2, *n2). */
BOOL Audio_LockBuffer(AudioBuffer *buffer, DWORD offset, DWORD bytes, void **p1, DWORD *n1, void **p2, DWORD *n2);
void Audio_UnlockBuffer(AudioBuffer *buffer);

void Audio_Play(AudioBuffer *buffer, BOOL loop);
void Audio_Stop(AudioBuffer *buffer);
BOOL Audio_IsPlaying(AudioBuffer *buffer);
DWORD Audio_GetPlayPosition(AudioBuffer *buffer);
void Audio_SetPlayPosition(AudioBuffer *buffer, DWORD position);

void Audio_SetVolume(AudioBuffer *buffer, LONG volume);
void Audio_SetPan(AudioBuffer *buffer, LONG pan);
void Audio_SetFrequency(AudioBuffer *buffer, DWORD frequency);

/* Queued float PCM for movie sound. The mixer resamples to its output rate.
   Starts after the first video frame is presented; releasing discards queued
   sound immediately, including when the user skips a movie. */
AudioStream *Audio_CreateStream(DWORD sampleRate, int channels);
BOOL Audio_QueueStream(AudioStream *stream, const float *samples, DWORD sampleCount);
void Audio_StartStream(AudioStream *stream);
void Audio_ReleaseStream(AudioStream *stream);

/* ---- wave files ---------------------------------------------------------- */

#define AUDIO_WAVE_FORMAT_PCM 1
#define AUDIO_WAVE_FORMAT_ADPCM 2

#pragma pack(push, 1)
/* The "fmt " chunk of a .wav file (WAVEFORMATEX); cbSize extra bytes follow. */
typedef struct AudioWaveFormat {
    WORD wFormatTag;
    WORD nChannels;
    DWORD nSamplesPerSec;
    DWORD nAvgBytesPerSec;
    WORD nBlockAlign;
    WORD wBitsPerSample;
    WORD cbSize;
} AudioWaveFormat;
#pragma pack(pop)

/* Decodes whole Microsoft ADPCM blocks (format from the file) into 16-bit
   PCM. Returns the number of bytes written; stops when dst is full. */
DWORD Audio_DecodeMsAdpcm(const AudioWaveFormat *format, const BYTE *src, DWORD srcBytes, BYTE *dst, DWORD dstBytes);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif
```

`src/port/disk.cpp`:

```cpp
// Native copies of file records, see port/disk.h.

#include "port/disk.h"
#include "port/types.h"
#include "port/sys.h"

#include <stdlib.h>

#include <vector>

#if defined(_WIN32)
#include <malloc.h>
#define ALLOCATION_SIZE(p) _msize(p)
#elif defined(__APPLE__)
#include <malloc/malloc.h>
#define ALLOCATION_SIZE(p) malloc_size(p)
#else
#include <malloc.h>
#define ALLOCATION_SIZE(p) malloc_usable_size(p)
#endif

namespace {

struct Attachment {
    const char *fileData;
    void *native;
};

// Few at a time: one per loaded stage mesh file.
std::vector<Attachment> s_attachments;

} // namespace

void Disk_Unpack(void *native, const void *record, const DiskLayout *layout)
{
    memset(native, 0, layout->nativeSize);
    for (int i = 0; i < layout->runCount; i++) {
        const DiskRun &run = layout->runs[i];
        memcpy((char *)native + run.native, (const char *)record + run.disk, run.size);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < layout->pointerCount; i++)
        memset((char *)native + layout->pointers[i].native, 0, sizeof(void *));
}

void Disk_Pack(void *record, const void *native, const DiskLayout *layout)
{
    memset(record, 0, layout->diskSize);
    for (int i = 0; i < layout->runCount; i++) {
        const DiskRun &run = layout->runs[i];
        memcpy((char *)record + run.disk, (const char *)native + run.native, run.size);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < layout->pointerCount; i++) {
        uintptr_t pointer;
        memcpy(&pointer, (const char *)native + layout->pointers[i].native, sizeof(pointer));
        uint32_t low = (uint32_t)pointer;
        memcpy((char *)record + layout->pointers[i].disk, &low, sizeof(low));
    }
}

void Disk_AttachToBuffer(const void *fileData, void *native)
{
    s_attachments.push_back({(const char *)fileData, native});
}

void Disk_ReleaseBuffer(void *buffer)
{
    if (buffer == NULL || s_attachments.empty())
        return;
    // The file data can sit inside a larger buffer (an archive).
    const char *begin = (const char *)buffer;
    const char *end = begin + ALLOCATION_SIZE(buffer);
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s_attachments.size();) {
        if (s_attachments[i].fileData >= begin && s_attachments[i].fileData < end) {
            free(s_attachments[i].native);
            s_attachments[i] = s_attachments.back();
            s_attachments.pop_back();
        } else {
            i++;
        }
    }
}

void Disk_BadOffset(const void *record, unsigned off, uint32_t value)
{
    Sys_Log("disk: record %p field 0x%x holds offset 0x%x outside its array", record, off, (unsigned)value);
}

```

`src/port/disk.h`:

```h
/*
 * Records the game loads from files whose 32-bit offsets the original turns
 * into pointers in place. On 64-bit targets the structures holding those
 * pointers are larger than the file records, so the port builds native
 * copies: Disk_Unpack copies a record's pointer-free bytes to the native
 * layout (port/disk_layouts.h, generated) and leaves its pointer fields NULL
 * for the loader to relocate. The same code runs on 32-bit targets, where the
 * layouts are the same.
 */
#ifndef OPENCMR2_PORT_DISK_H
#define OPENCMR2_PORT_DISK_H

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>

struct DiskRun {
    unsigned short disk, native, size;
};

struct DiskPointer {
    unsigned short disk, native;
};

struct DiskLayout {
    unsigned short diskSize;
    unsigned short nativeSize;
    const DiskRun *runs;
    int runCount;
    const DiskPointer *pointers;
    int pointerCount;
};

/* The 32-bit value at offset off of a file record. -1 means none. */
static inline uint32_t Disk_Offset(const void *record, unsigned off)
{
    uint32_t value;
    memcpy(&value, (const char *)record + off, sizeof(value));
    return value;
}

/* Reports an offset that is not a record of the array it should point into. */
void Disk_BadOffset(const void *record, unsigned off, uint32_t value);

#ifdef __cplusplus
/* The native record a relocated file offset points to: the file array holds
 * records of diskSize bytes, the native one count elements. -1 is none. */
template <typename T>
static inline T *Disk_Record(const void *record, unsigned off, T *array, unsigned diskSize, unsigned count)
{
    uint32_t value = Disk_Offset(record, off);
    if (value == 0xffffffffu)
        return NULL;
    if (value % diskSize != 0 || value / diskSize >= count) {
        Disk_BadOffset(record, off, value);
        return NULL;
    }
    return &array[value / diskSize];
}
#define DISK_RECORD(record, off, array, Type, count) \
    Disk_Record<Type>((record), (off), (array), g_diskLayout_##Type.diskSize, (count))
#endif

/* A relocated offset into pointer-free file data at base. -1 is none. */
static inline void *Disk_Data(const void *record, unsigned off, void *base)
{
    uint32_t value = Disk_Offset(record, off);
    return value == 0xffffffffu ? NULL : (char *)base + value;
}
#define DISK_DATA(record, off, base) Disk_Data((record), (off), (base))

/* Copies a file record to native storage; pointer fields become NULL. */
void Disk_Unpack(void *native, const void *record, const DiskLayout *layout);

/* The reverse: writes a native record in the file layout; pointer fields
 * keep the low 32 bits of the pointer (addresses are not comparable anyway). */
void Disk_Pack(void *record, const void *native, const DiskLayout *layout);

/* Frees native storage together with the game buffer that holds fileData:
 * CFileBuffer::FreeGenericFileBuffer of that buffer frees it. */
void Disk_AttachToBuffer(const void *fileData, void *native);
/* Called with every game buffer about to be freed. */
void Disk_ReleaseBuffer(void *buffer);

#endif

```

`src/port/disk_layouts.h`:

```h
// Generated by tools/gen_disk_layouts.py from the game headers. Do not edit.
// File records of the stage mesh loader (see that script): byte runs copied
// as they are and pointer fields stored as 32-bit file offsets.
#ifndef OPENCMR2_PORT_DISK_LAYOUTS_H
#define OPENCMR2_PORT_DISK_LAYOUTS_H

#include "port/disk.h"
#include "SceneNode.h"
#include "Mesh.h"
#include "Sector.h"
#include "MeshCollisionRecord.h"
#include "Car.h"
#include "CarParts.h"
#include "ReplayStream.h"

// SceneNode: 0x18c bytes in files, 0x1a0 on 64-bit targets.
#if UINTPTR_MAX > 0xffffffffu
static const DiskRun g_diskRuns_SceneNode[] = {
    {0x10, 0x20, 0x160},
    {0x174, 0x188, 0x18},
};
static const DiskPointer g_diskPointers_SceneNode[] = {
    {0x0, 0x0}, // pNext
    {0x4, 0x8}, // pFirstChild
    {0x8, 0x10}, // pParent
    {0xc, 0x18}, // pObject
    {0x170, 0x180}, // pNextInSector
};
static_assert(sizeof(SceneNode) == 0x1a0, "run tools/gen_disk_layouts.py");
#else
static const DiskRun g_diskRuns_SceneNode[] = {{0, 0, 0x18c}};
static const DiskPointer g_diskPointers_SceneNode[] = {
    {0x0, 0x0}, // pNext
    {0x4, 0x4}, // pFirstChild
    {0x8, 0x8}, // pParent
    {0xc, 0xc}, // pObject
    {0x170, 0x170}, // pNextInSector
};
static_assert(sizeof(SceneNode) == 0x18c, "run tools/gen_disk_layouts.py");
#endif
static const DiskLayout g_diskLayout_SceneNode = {0x18c, sizeof(SceneNode), g_diskRuns_SceneNode, sizeof(g_diskRuns_SceneNode) / sizeof(DiskRun), g_diskPointers_SceneNode, sizeof(g_diskPointers_SceneNode) / sizeof(DiskPointer)};
#define DISK_SceneNode_pNext 0x0
#define DISK_SceneNode_pFirstChild 0x4
#define DISK_SceneNode_pParent 0x8
#define DISK_SceneNode_pObject 0xc
#define DISK_SceneNode_pNextInSector 0x170
```

`src/port/gfx.h`:

```h
/*
 * OpenCMR2 renderer interface, implemented in src/render on SDL_GPU.
 *
 * It exposes the rendering model CMR2 was written for (Direct3D 7's
 * fixed-function pipeline) as immediate-mode calls on our own types: state
 * setters, then draws that use the current state. Draws are recorded with a
 * copy of their vertices and indices, so the game may overwrite its buffers
 * right after drawing, as it could with Direct3D.
 *
 * Enumerated values equal the original Direct3D constants, because the game
 * keeps them in its data and passes them around as plain numbers.
 */
#ifndef OPENCMR2_PORT_GFX_H
#define OPENCMR2_PORT_GFX_H

#include "port/types.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* ---- types ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

typedef struct GfxTexture GfxTexture;
typedef struct GfxVertexBuffer GfxVertexBuffer;

/* Row-vector matrix, Direct3D layout: v' = v * M, translation in _41.._43. */
typedef struct GfxMatrix {
    float _11, _12, _13, _14;
    float _21, _22, _23, _24;
    float _31, _32, _33, _34;
    float _41, _42, _43, _44;
} GfxMatrix;

typedef struct GfxVector {
    float x, y, z;
} GfxVector;

typedef struct GfxColorValue {
    float r, g, b, a;
} GfxColorValue;

/* Colours are 0xAARRGGBB. */
#define GFX_RGBA(r, g, b, a) \
    ((DWORD)((((a) & 0xff) << 24) | (((r) & 0xff) << 16) | (((g) & 0xff) << 8) | ((b) & 0xff)))

/* 3D vertex: position, normal, diffuse, specular, two texture coordinate
   sets (Direct3D FVF 0x2d2, 48 bytes). Lit and transformed by the device. */
typedef struct GfxVertex {
    float x, y, z;
    float nx, ny, nz;
    DWORD diffuse;
    DWORD specular;
    float u0, v0;
    float u1, v1;
} GfxVertex;

enum GfxFormat {
    GFX_FORMAT_BGRX8,         /* 32-bit, no alpha */
    GFX_FORMAT_BGRA8,         /* 32-bit with alpha */
    GFX_FORMAT_BC1,           /* DXT1 */
    GFX_FORMAT_BC3,           /* DXT5 */
    GFX_FORMAT_BUMP_DUDVL     /* 24-bit: signed dU, signed dV, luminance (L8V8U8) */
};

enum GfxPixelFormatFlags {
    GFX_PF_ALPHA = 0x1,     /* has an alpha channel */
    GFX_PF_FOURCC = 0x4,    /* compressed, see fourCC */
    GFX_PF_RGB = 0x40,
    GFX_PF_BUMP = 0x40000   /* dU/dV/luminance */
};

/* Layout of a format, for the game's pixel code (DDPIXELFORMAT's flags). */
typedef struct GfxPixelFormat {
    DWORD flags;
    DWORD bitsPerPixel;
    DWORD redMask, greenMask, blueMask, alphaMask;   /* bump: dU, dV, luminance masks */
    DWORD fourCC;                                     /* compressed formats: 'DXT1', 'DXT5' */
} GfxPixelFormat;
void Gfx_GetPixelFormat(int format, GfxPixelFormat *out);

enum GfxTextureFlags {
    GFX_TEXTURE_RENDER_TARGET = 1,    /* can be drawn into (with its own depth buffer) */
    GFX_TEXTURE_CUBE = 2,             /* six faces */
    GFX_TEXTURE_DYNAMIC = 4,          /* changed often */
    GFX_TEXTURE_STAGING = 8           /* CPU only: a source for Gfx_CopyTexture */
};

/* mipLevels counts the top level (1 = no mipmaps). */
GfxTexture *Gfx_CreateTexture(int width, int height, int format, int mipLevels, DWORD flags);
void Gfx_DestroyTexture(GfxTexture *texture);
int Gfx_GetTextureMipCount(GfxTexture *texture);

typedef struct GfxLockedRect {
    void *pixels;
    LONG pitch;               /* bytes per row (per row of 4x4 blocks if compressed) */
    DWORD width, height;      /* of the mip level */
    GfxPixelFormat format;
} GfxLockedRect;

/* Locks a mip level of a face for reading and writing; the texture is
   updated on the GPU when it is unlocked. */
BOOL Gfx_LockTexture(GfxTexture *texture, int face, int mip, GfxLockedRect *out);
void Gfx_UnlockTexture(GfxTexture *texture, int face, int mip);

/* Fills the lower mip levels from the top one (box filter). */
void Gfx_GenerateMipmaps(GfxTexture *texture);
/* Copies the top level of src into dst, converting the format (compressed
   sources are decoded) and stretching to dst's size like a DirectDraw Blt. */
void Gfx_CopyTexture(GfxTexture *dst, GfxTexture *src);

/* Cube maps: a texture for one face, usable as a render target. Face 0 is
   the cube itself; destroying a face does nothing. */
GfxTexture *Gfx_GetCubeFace(GfxTexture *cube, int face);

/* Asks for a copy of a rectangle of the back buffer at the end of this frame
   and returns, in pixels (width * height colours, 0xAARRGGBB, rows top to
   bottom), the copy taken at the end of the previous frame. Returns 0 when
   there is none yet for a rectangle of that size. */
BOOL Gfx_ReadBackBuffer(int x, int y, int width, int height, DWORD *pixels);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif
```

`src/port/input.h`:

```h
/*
 * OpenCMR2 input interface, implemented in src/input on SDL3.
 *
 * The game was written against DirectInput and keeps its model: devices it
 * polls each frame, keyboard state indexed by DirectInput scan codes (DIK_*,
 * the key codes in its bindings and save files), joystick axes scaled to a
 * range the game sets, POV hats in hundredths of a degree, buttons with bit
 * 0x80 set while held, and force-feedback effects.
 *
 * Joystick objects are named by their DirectInput data-format offsets
 * (DIJOFS_*): axes X, Y, Z, Rx, Ry, Rz at 0x00..0x14, sliders at 0x18 and
 * 0x1c, POV hats at 0x20 + 4 * n, buttons at 0x30 + n.
 */
#ifndef OPENCMR2_PORT_INPUT_H
#define OPENCMR2_PORT_INPUT_H

#include "port/types.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct InputDevice InputDevice;
typedef struct InputEffect InputEffect;

#define INPUT_OFFSET_X 0x00
#define INPUT_OFFSET_Y 0x04
#define INPUT_OFFSET_Z 0x08
#define INPUT_OFFSET_RX 0x0c
#define INPUT_OFFSET_RY 0x10
#define INPUT_OFFSET_RZ 0x14
#define INPUT_OFFSET_SLIDER(n) (0x18 + 4 * (n))
#define INPUT_OFFSET_POV(n) (0x20 + 4 * (n))
#define INPUT_OFFSET_BUTTON(n) (0x30 + (n))

/* Key codes: DirectInput scan codes (the ones the game names). */
#define INPUT_KEY_ESCAPE 0x01
#define INPUT_KEY_RETURN 0x1C
#define INPUT_KEY_NUMPADENTER 0x9C
#define INPUT_KEY_LSHIFT 0x2A
#define INPUT_KEY_SPACE 0x39
#define INPUT_KEY_RSHIFT 0x36
#define INPUT_KEY_F1 0x3B
#define INPUT_KEY_F2 0x3C
#define INPUT_KEY_UP 0xC8
#define INPUT_KEY_LEFT 0xCB
#define INPUT_KEY_RIGHT 0xCD
#define INPUT_KEY_DOWN 0xD0

/* POV value when centred. */
#define INPUT_POV_CENTERED 0xffffffff

typedef struct InputMouseState {
    LONG lX, lY, lZ;            /* movement since the last read */
    BYTE rgbButtons[8];
} InputMouseState;

typedef struct InputJoystickState {
    LONG lX, lY, lZ;
    LONG lRx, lRy, lRz;
    LONG rglSlider[2];
    DWORD rgdwPOV[4];
    BYTE rgbButtons[128];
} InputJoystickState;

typedef struct InputCaps {
    DWORD axes;
    DWORD buttons;
    DWORD povs;
    BOOL forceFeedback;
} InputCaps;

/* ---- devices ---------------------------------------------------------------- */

/* Joysticks the game can use: its controller table holds two keyboard
   configurations and four devices. */
int Input_GetJoystickCount(void);
/* Whether joysticks were connected or disconnected since they were opened. */
BOOL Input_JoysticksChanged(void);

InputDevice *Input_OpenKeyboard(void);
InputDevice *Input_OpenMouse(void);
InputDevice *Input_OpenJoystick(int index);
/* A controller in the Xbox layout (see input_sdl.cpp), rather than a raw
   joystick or wheel. */
BOOL Input_IsGamepad(InputDevice *device);
void Input_CloseDevice(InputDevice *device);

const char *Input_GetInstanceName(InputDevice *device);
const char *Input_GetProductName(InputDevice *device);
void Input_GetCaps(InputDevice *device, InputCaps *caps);
/* Name of a joystick object by offset; 0 when the device has no such object. */
BOOL Input_GetObjectName(InputDevice *device, DWORD offset, char *name, size_t size);
/* Whether the joystick has the axis at that offset. */
BOOL Input_HasAxis(InputDevice *device, DWORD offset);

/* Axis properties, as DirectInput's DIPROP_RANGE / DEADZONE / SATURATION
   (dead zone and saturation in 0..10000 of the range). */
void Input_SetAxisRange(InputDevice *device, DWORD offset, LONG min, LONG max);
void Input_SetAxisDeadzone(InputDevice *device, DWORD offset, DWORD deadzone);
void Input_SetAxisSaturation(InputDevice *device, DWORD offset, DWORD saturation);

/* Mouse capture: exclusive (relative, hidden) or shared. */
void Input_SetMouseExclusive(InputDevice *device, BOOL exclusive);

BOOL Input_ReadKeyboard(InputDevice *device, BYTE keys[256]);
BOOL Input_ReadMouse(InputDevice *device, InputMouseState *state);
BOOL Input_ReadJoystick(InputDevice *device, InputJoystickState *state);

/* Whether a key is held right now (GetAsyncKeyState). */
BOOL Input_IsKeyDown(int key);

/* Keyboard auto-repeat of the system, in milliseconds. */
void Input_GetKeyRepeat(DWORD *delay, DWORD *interval);
/* Name of a key (DIK_*) in the current keyboard layout. */
const char *Input_GetKeyName(int key);

/* ---- force feedback --------------------------------------------------------- */

enum InputEffectType {
    INPUT_EFFECT_CONSTANT,
    INPUT_EFFECT_SPRING,
    INPUT_EFFECT_DAMPER,
    INPUT_EFFECT_INERTIA,
    INPUT_EFFECT_FRICTION
};

#define INPUT_EFFECT_INFINITE 0xffffffff
#define INPUT_EFFECT_NO_TRIGGER 0xffffffff

/* DirectInput's DIEFFECT with its type-specific parameters folded in.
   Times in microseconds, levels and gains in 0..10000. */
typedef struct InputEffectParams {
    int type;
    DWORD duration;
    DWORD gain;
    DWORD triggerButton;        /* INPUT_OFFSET_BUTTON(n) or INPUT_EFFECT_NO_TRIGGER */
    LONG direction;             /* constant force: polar, hundredths of a degree */
    LONG magnitude;             /* constant force */
    DWORD attackTime, attackLevel, fadeTime, fadeLevel;   /* constant force envelope */
    LONG coefficient;           /* conditions (spring, damper, ...) */
    LONG offset;
    DWORD saturation;
    LONG deadBand;
} InputEffectParams;

InputEffect *Input_CreateEffect(InputDevice *device, const InputEffectParams *params);
void Input_UpdateEffect(InputEffect *effect, const InputEffectParams *params);
void Input_StartEffect(InputEffect *effect);
BOOL Input_IsEffectPlaying(InputEffect *effect);
void Input_DestroyEffect(InputEffect *effect);
void Input_StopAllEffects(InputDevice *device);
void Input_SetAutocenter(InputDevice *device, BOOL enable);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif
```

`src/port/movie.h`:

```h
/*
 * OpenCMR2 movie playback, implemented in src/video: an in-tree decoder for
 * the game's Bink 1 files (revision 'i'), with no external codec library.
 *
 * It follows Bink's playback model, which the game's movie loop is written
 * for: decode the current frame, show it, advance, and wait until it is time
 * for the next one. The sound track plays through the audio layer.
 */
#ifndef OPENCMR2_PORT_MOVIE_H
#define OPENCMR2_PORT_MOVIE_H

#include "port/types.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef struct Movie Movie;

/* Opens a game path; audioTrack selects the sound track (language). */
Movie *Movie_Open(const char *path, int audioTrack);
void Movie_Close(Movie *movie);

DWORD Movie_GetWidth(Movie *movie);
DWORD Movie_GetHeight(Movie *movie);
/* Frame numbers count from 1, as Bink's FrameNum. */
DWORD Movie_GetFrameNumber(Movie *movie);
DWORD Movie_GetFrameCount(Movie *movie);

/* Decodes the current frame (BinkDoFrame). */
void Movie_DecodeFrame(Movie *movie);
/* Moves to the next frame (BinkNextFrame). */
void Movie_NextFrame(Movie *movie);
/* Returns 1 while it is too early to show the next frame (BinkWait). */
BOOL Movie_Wait(Movie *movie);

/* Draws the decoded frame stretched into the rectangle (back buffer pixels),
   with black around it, and presents. */
void Movie_Present(Movie *movie, int x, int y, int width, int height);

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif
```

`src/port/msvcrt.h`:

```h
/*
 * The MSVC 6 C runtime behaviour the decompiled game depends on.
 *
 * Force-included after types.h. rand() must be the MSVC generator: the game
 * seeds it (srand(400) in stage objects) and draws gameplay values from it,
 * and glibc's rand() is a different generator with a different RAND_MAX.
 * The other names are MSVC spellings of C library functions.
 */
#ifndef OPENCMR2_PORT_MSVCRT_H
#define OPENCMR2_PORT_MSVCRT_H

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#ifndef _WIN32
#include <strings.h>
#endif

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

/* MSVC's linear congruential generator, 15-bit results. */
int Crt_Rand(void);
void Crt_Srand(unsigned int seed);
/* Read-only diagnostic view; does not draw a random value. */
unsigned int Crt_GetRandState(void);
#undef RAND_MAX
#define RAND_MAX 0x7fff
#define rand Crt_Rand
#define srand Crt_Srand

char *Crt_Strlwr(char *s);
char *Crt_Strupr(char *s);
char *Crt_Itoa(int value, char *buffer, int radix);
/* Splits a DOS path ('\\' or '/' separators, optional drive letter). */
void Crt_SplitPath(const char *path, char *drive, char *dir, char *fname, char *ext);

#ifdef _WIN32
#define stricmp _stricmp
#else
#define _stricmp strcasecmp
#define _strnicmp strncasecmp
#define stricmp strcasecmp
#endif
#define _strlwr Crt_Strlwr
#define _strupr Crt_Strupr
#define _itoa Crt_Itoa
#define _splitpath Crt_SplitPath
#define _snprintf snprintf
#define _vsnprintf vsnprintf

#define _MAX_PATH 260
#define _MAX_DRIVE 3
#define _MAX_DIR 256
#define _MAX_FNAME 256
#define _MAX_EXT 256

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif

#endif
```

`src/port/net.h`:

```h
/*
 * OpenCMR2 network sessions, implemented in src/net (replaces DirectPlay).
 *
 * The game's network code is written for DirectPlay 4 and keeps its model:
 * a service provider ("connection") is chosen, sessions are enumerated,
 * hosted or joined, each machine creates its player, and messages go from a
 * player to one player or to all of them. System messages (players joining
 * and leaving, becoming the host, player data and session changes) arrive
 * through Net_Receive from NET_ID_SYSTEM with DirectPlay's layouts, which the
 * game reads by offset.
 *
 * Result codes and system message types have DirectPlay's values.
 */
#ifndef OPENCMR2_PORT_NET_H
#define OPENCMR2_PORT_NET_H

#include "port/types.h"

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

typedef DWORD NetPlayerID;

#define NET_ID_SYSTEM 0         /* sender of system messages */
#define NET_ID_ALL 0            /* send to every player */

/* ---- results ---- */
#define NET_OK 0
#define NET_ERR_MAKE(code) ((HRESULT)(0x88770000 | (code)))
#define NET_ERR_ACCESSDENIED NET_ERR_MAKE(10)
#define NET_ERR_ALREADYINITIALIZED NET_ERR_MAKE(5)
#define NET_ERR_BUFFERTOOSMALL NET_ERR_MAKE(30)
#define NET_ERR_CONNECTIONLOST NET_ERR_MAKE(500)
#define NET_ERR_GENERIC ((HRESULT)0x80004005)
#define NET_ERR_INVALIDFLAGS NET_ERR_MAKE(120)
#define NET_ERR_INVALIDOBJECT NET_ERR_MAKE(130)
#define NET_ERR_INVALIDPARAMS ((HRESULT)0x80070057)
#define NET_ERR_INVALIDPASSWORD NET_ERR_MAKE(360)
#define NET_ERR_INVALIDPLAYER NET_ERR_MAKE(150)
#define NET_ERR_NOCONNECTION NET_ERR_MAKE(200)
#define NET_ERR_NOMESSAGES NET_ERR_MAKE(190)
#define NET_ERR_NONEWPLAYERS NET_ERR_MAKE(230)
#define NET_ERR_TIMEOUT NET_ERR_MAKE(270)
#define NET_ERR_UNAVAILABLE NET_ERR_MAKE(280)
#define NET_ERR_UNINITIALIZED NET_ERR_MAKE(350)
#define NET_ERR_USERCANCEL NET_ERR_MAKE(380)

/* ---- data ---- */

typedef struct NetGuid {
    BYTE bytes[16];
} NetGuid;

/* DPSESSIONDESC2. */
typedef struct NetSessionDesc {
    DWORD dwSize;
    DWORD dwFlags;
    NetGuid guidInstance;
    NetGuid guidApplication;
    DWORD dwMaxPlayers;
    DWORD dwCurrentPlayers;
    char *lpszSessionNameA;
    char *lpszPasswordA;
    DWORD dwReserved1;
    DWORD dwReserved2;
    DWORD dwUser1;
    DWORD dwUser2;
    DWORD dwUser3;
    DWORD dwUser4;
} NetSessionDesc;

/* DPNAME. */
typedef struct NetName {
    DWORD dwSize;
    DWORD dwFlags;
```
