```cpp
// Follow archive loading, displayed language labels and the actual selection
// callback with synthetic PC assets. No GPU or original game files needed.
#include "port/types.h"
#include "Frontend.h"
#include "GameInfo.h"
#include "Graphics.h"
#include "InstallInfo.h"
#include "Menu.h"
#include "main.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>

extern BYTE FrontendText_LoadRegionLanguages();
extern BYTE FrontendText_ReleaseRegionLanguages();
extern bool FrontendCredits_ReleaseText();
extern void FrontendMenu_BuildLanguage();
extern Menu *FrontendMenu_GetLanguage();
extern void FrontendMenu_LeaveLanguage(Menu *, char);
extern void Frontend_SelectTextLanguage(int);
extern void *g_creditsLines;

namespace fs = std::filesystem;

static void Check(bool ok, const char *message)
{
    if (!ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "frontend language: %s\n", message);
        exit(1);
    }
}

static void Write(const fs::path &path, const std::string &bytes)
{
    fs::create_directories(path.parent_path());
    Check(SDL_SaveFile(path.u8string().c_str(), bytes.data(), bytes.size()), "write fixture");
}

static void Dword(std::string &bytes, unsigned value)
{
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < 4; ++i)
        bytes += char(value >> (i * 8));
}

static std::string Archive(const std::string &name, const std::string &text)
{
    std::string bytes = text;
    while (bytes.size() % 4)
        bytes += '\0';
    const unsigned index = unsigned(bytes.size());
    Dword(bytes, unsigned(text.size()));
    Dword(bytes, 0);
    Dword(bytes, unsigned(name.size()));
    bytes += name;
    while (bytes.size() % 4)
        bytes += '\0';
    Dword(bytes, index);
    std::string header = "CMPR";
    Dword(header, unsigned(bytes.size()));
    return header + bytes;
}

static void CreateRegion(const fs::path &data, int region)
{
    const char *names[] = {region == 0 ? "english" : "engusa", "french", "spanish", "italian", "german"};
    const char *labels[] = {"english", "fran\xe7" "ais", "espa\xf1ol", "italiano", "deutsch"};
    const int count = region == 0 ? 5 : 3;
    const fs::path country = data / "CountrySpecific" / (region == 0 ? "Europe" : "Usa");
    for (int language = 0; language < count; ++language) {
        std::string text;
        for (int line = 0; line < 0x215; ++line) {
            const char *label = names[language];
            if (line >= 6 && line <= 10) {
                // EU text files label 8 deutsch and 10 español. These text
                // IDs differ from the archive/language numbers (2/4).
                const int order[] = {0, 1, region == 0 ? 4 : 2, 3, 2};
                label = labels[order[line - 6]];
            }
            text += std::string(label) + "\r\n";
        }
        Write(country / (std::string(names[language]) + "text.bfl"),
              Archive(std::string("f") + names[language] + ".txt", text));
        Write(country / (std::string("credits_") + (language == 0 && region == 1 ? "usa" :
              language == 1 && region == 1 ? "frenchusa" : language == 2 && region == 1 ? "spanishusa" : names[language]) + ".txt"),
              std::string("\"test\" \"") + names[language] + "\"\r\n");
    }
    Write(country / "FERes640E.bfl", "synthetic resources");
    Write(country / "FERes640EC.bfl", "synthetic resources");
}

static void TestRegion(int region)
{
    const char *names[] = {region == 0 ? "english" : "engusa", "french", "spanish", "italian", "german"};
    const char *labels[] = {"english", "fran\xe7" "ais", "espa\xf1ol", "italiano", "deutsch"};
    const int count = region == 0 ? 5 : 3;
    CGameInfo::SetGameRegion(region);
    CGameInfo::InitRegionLanguageCount();
    CFrontend::LoadLanguageFiles();
    Check(FrontendText_LoadRegionLanguages() != 0, "load regional frontend text");
    FrontendMenu_BuildLanguage();
    Menu *menu = FrontendMenu_GetLanguage();
    Check(menu->itemCount == count, "region has the right number of languages");
    Menu parent{};
    Menu_SetParent(menu, &parent); // existing options menu, no first-run controls setup
    for (int current = 0; current < count; ++current) {
        Frontend_SelectTextLanguage(current);
        for (int language = 0; language < count; ++language) {
            Check(std::string(CFrontend::GetTextString(menu->items[language].id)) == labels[language],
                  "displayed language label matches its archive number");
            Menu_SetCursor(menu, BYTE(language));
            FrontendMenu_LeaveLanguage(menu, 0);
            Check(CGameInfo::GetGameLanguage() == language, "selection stores the chosen language");
            Check(std::string(CFrontend::GetTextString(0)) == names[language], "selection displays the chosen archive's text");
            Check(g_creditsLines && std::string(((char **)g_creditsLines)[1]) == names[language],
                  "selection loads matching credits");
        }
    }
    Menu_SetCursor(menu, 0);
    FrontendMenu_LeaveLanguage(menu, 1);
    Check(CGameInfo::GetGameLanguage() == count - 1, "cancel preserves the current language");
    FrontendCredits_ReleaseText();
    FrontendText_ReleaseRegionLanguages();
    CFrontend::ReleaseLanguageFiles();
}

int main()
{
    const fs::path root = fs::temp_directory_path() / ("opencmr2-language-" + std::to_string(SDL_GetPerformanceCounter()));
    const fs::path data = root / "Data", user = root / "user";
    Write(data / "Game/Bigfiles/common.bfl", "synthetic archive");
    Write(data / "FrontEnd/common.bfl", "synthetic archive");
    Write(data / "FrontEnd/Res640.bfl", "synthetic resources");
    Write(data / "FrontEnd/Res640C.bfl", "synthetic resources");
    Write(data / "Sounds/surface.bfl", "synthetic archive");
    Write(user / "opencmr2.ini", "[install]\nmenu_shortcut = 0\n");
    CreateRegion(data, 0);
    CreateRegion(data, 1);
    // A missing fixture must fail even if the game's error dialog exits.
    CMain::m_exitCode = 1;
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_VIDEO_DRIVER, "dummy");
    std::string dataPath = data.u8string(), userPath = user.u8string();
    char program[] = "frontend_language", dataFlag[] = "--data", userFlag[] = "--user-dir";
    char *args[] = {program, dataFlag, dataPath.data(), userFlag, userPath.data()};
    Check(Platform_Init(5, args), "initialise platform with synthetic assets");
    Check(CInstallInfo::LoadInstallPathsFromRegistry() != 0, "initialise install paths");
    Graphics graphics{};
    graphics.resX = 640;
    graphics.resY = 480;
    g_pGraphics = &graphics;
    TestRegion(0);
    TestRegion(1);
    g_pGraphics = nullptr;
    Platform_Shutdown();
    fs::remove_all(root);
    puts("frontend language: EU/USA labels, selected text, credits and cancellation passed");
}
```

`tests/ftoi_fistp.cpp`:

```cpp
// FTOI (game/FloatToInt.h) in a CMR2_QIFIST unit against the x87 FISTP that
// MSVC6 /QIfist emits: 16-, 32- and 64-bit stores under the game's control
// word 0x027f, for halves, negatives, large values, out of range and NaN.
#define CMR2_QIFIST
#include "FloatToInt.h"

#include <cmath>
#include <cstdint>
#include <cstdio>
#include <limits>
#include <random>
#include <vector>

static unsigned short SetControlWord(unsigned short cw)
{
    unsigned short old;
    __asm__ volatile("fnstcw %0" : "=m"(old));
    __asm__ volatile("fldcw %0" : : "m"(cw));
    return old;
}

static int64_t Fistp64(double x)
{
    int64_t r;
    __asm__ volatile("fistpll %0" : "=m"(r) : "t"(x) : "st");
    return r;
}

static int32_t Fistp32(double x)
{
    int32_t r;
    __asm__ volatile("fistpl %0" : "=m"(r) : "t"(x) : "st");
    return r;
}

int main()
{
    unsigned short saved = SetControlWord(0x027f);
    std::vector<double> values = {0.0, -0.0, 0.5, 1.5, 2.5, -0.5, -1.5, -2.5, 0.49999999999999994, 1e9 + 0.5,
                                  2147483647.0, 2147483647.4, 2147483647.5, 2147483648.0, -2147483648.0,
                                  -2147483648.5, -2147483649.0, 4294967295.0, 4294967296.0, 9.2e18, -9.3e18, 1e300,
                                  -1e300, std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(),
                                  -std::numeric_limits<double>::infinity(), std::nan("")};
    std::mt19937_64 rng(1);
    std::uniform_real_distribution<double> wide(-3e9, 3e9), narrow(-70000.0, 70000.0);
    for (int i = 0; i < 200000; i++) {
        values.push_back(wide(rng));
        values.push_back(std::round(narrow(rng) * 2) / 2);  // exact halves
        values.push_back((float)narrow(rng) * 65536.0f);   // a float operand, as the game converts
    }
    int failures = 0;
    for (double x : values) {
        struct {
            const char *what;
            long long got, want;
        } checks[] = {
            {"int", FTOI(int, x), Fistp32(x)},
            {"__int64", FTOI(__int64, x), Fistp64(x)},
            {"(int)__int64", (int)FTOI(__int64, x), (int)Fistp64(x)},
            {"unsigned", FTOI(unsigned int, x), (unsigned int)Fistp64(x)},
            {"short", FTOI(short, x), (short)Fistp32(x)},
        };
        for (auto &c : checks) {
            if (c.got != c.want && failures++ < 20)
                fprintf(stderr, "FTOI(%s, %.17g) = %lld, FISTP %lld\n", c.what, x, c.got, c.want);
        }
    }
    SetControlWord(saved);
    if (failures) {
        fprintf(stderr, "%d mismatches\n", failures);
        return 1;
    }
    printf("FTOI matches x87 FISTP for %zu values\n", values.size());
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/game_data_setup.cpp`:

```cpp
// Exercise the actual startup flow with synthetic data and desktop dialogs.
// No original assets, display server or interaction are needed in CI.
#include "port/types.h"
#include "InstallInfo.h"
#include "platform/platform.h"
#include "platform/testing.h"
#include "port/sys.h"

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <filesystem>
#include <string>
#include <thread>
#include <vector>

namespace fs = std::filesystem;
static std::vector<std::string> folders, messages;
static std::vector<std::thread> callbacks;
static int dialogs;
static bool exitSetup, dialogError, exitOnWarning;

static void Check(bool condition, const char *message)
{
    if (!condition) {
        fprintf(stderr, "game data setup: %s (%s)\n", message, SDL_GetError());
        exit(1);
    }
}

static std::string Read(const fs::path &path)
{
    size_t length = 0;
    char *data = (char *)SDL_LoadFile(path.u8string().c_str(), &length);
    Check(data != nullptr, "read fixture");
    std::string result(data, length);
    SDL_free(data);
    return result;
}

static void Write(const fs::path &path, const std::string &data)
{
    fs::create_directories(path.parent_path());
    Check(SDL_SaveFile(path.u8string().c_str(), data.data(), data.size()), "write fixture");
}

static bool MessageBox(const SDL_MessageBoxData *box, int *button)
{
    messages.emplace_back(box->message);
    Check(box->numbuttons == 2, "setup has select and exit buttons");
    *button = exitSetup || (exitOnWarning && box->flags == SDL_MESSAGEBOX_WARNING) ? 0 : 1;
    return true;
}

static void OpenFolder(SDL_DialogFileCallback callback, void *userdata)
{
    ++dialogs;
    Check(!folders.empty() || dialogError, "unexpected folder selector");
    std::string path;
    if (!folders.empty()) {
        path = folders.front();
        folders.erase(folders.begin());
    }
    // Real SDL callbacks can arrive from a worker thread; their path storage
    // expires on return. Delaying also makes startup pump events while waiting.
    callbacks.emplace_back([=] {
        SDL_Delay(20);
        if (dialogError) {
            SDL_SetError("No desktop folder selector available");
            callback(userdata, nullptr, -1);
            return;
        }
        const char *files[] = {path.empty() ? nullptr : path.c_str(), nullptr};
        callback(userdata, files, -1);
    });
}

static void CheckInstallPaths()
{
    // Platform_Init alone stops before the game's install-path setup. Exercise
    // that next step too: fixed-argument casts of sprintf used to crash here
    // on macOS ARM64, whose variadic arguments have a different calling ABI.
    Check(CInstallInfo::LoadInstallPathsFromRegistry() == 1, "load game install paths");
    const struct { const char *actual, *expected; } paths[] = {
        {CInstallInfo::GetGameHDPath(), "."},
        {CInstallInfo::GetGameCDPath(), "."},
        {CInstallInfo::GetTracksDir(), ".\\Game\\Tracks"},
        {CInstallInfo::GetCarsDir(), ".\\Game\\Cars"},
        {CInstallInfo::GetSoundsDir(), ".\\sounds"},
        {CInstallInfo::GetMusicDir(), ".\\sounds\\music"},
        {CInstallInfo::GetVideosDir(), ".\\FrontEnd\\Videos"},
        {CInstallInfo::GetFrontendDir(), ".\\FrontEnd"},
        {CInstallInfo::GetCountrySpecificDir(), ".\\CountrySpecific"},
        {CInstallInfo::GetCountrySpecificOtherDir(), ".\\CountrySpecific"},
        {CInstallInfo::GetSetupRepDir(), ".\\SetupRep"},
        {CInstallInfo::GetBigFilesDir(), ".\\Game\\BigFiles"},
        {CInstallInfo::GetTexturesDirectory(), ".\\Textures"},
        {CInstallInfo::GetFontsDir(), ".\\Fonts"},
    };
    for (const auto &path : paths)
        Check(std::string(path.actual) == path.expected, path.expected);
}

static bool Start(const fs::path &user, const std::string &explicitData = "")
{
    // SDL_Quit discards its environment snapshot between startup attempts.
    Check(SDL_SetEnvironmentVariable(SDL_GetEnvironment(), "SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy", true), "dummy video");
    SDL_UnsetEnvironmentVariable(SDL_GetEnvironment(), "OPENCMR2_DATA");
    std::string userPath = user.u8string(), data = explicitData;
    char name[] = "game_data_setup", userFlag[] = "--user-dir", dataFlag[] = "--data";
    char *args[] = {name, userFlag, userPath.data(), dataFlag, data.data()};
    bool started = Platform_Init(explicitData.empty() ? 3 : 5, args);
    for (auto &thread : callbacks)
        thread.join();
    callbacks.clear();
    if (started)
        CheckInstallPaths();
    return started;
}

int main()
{
    const fs::path previous = fs::current_path();
    const fs::path root = fs::canonical(fs::temp_directory_path()) /
        ("opencmr2-setup-" + std::to_string(SDL_GetPerformanceCounter()));
    fs::create_directories(root);
    fs::current_path(root);
    const fs::path user = root / fs::u8path(u8"ajustes ñ"), game = root / fs::u8path(u8"juego é con espacios");
    const fs::path ini = user / "opencmr2.ini";
    Write(game / "GAME/Bigfiles/COMMON.BFL", "synthetic main archive");
    Write(game / "frontend/Common.bfl", "synthetic frontend archive");
    Write(game / "Sounds/surface.bfl", "synthetic sound archive");
    Write(root / "incomplete/Game/Bigfiles/common.bfl", "synthetic");
    Write(root / "incomplete/FrontEnd/common.bfl", "");
    fs::create_directories(root / "incomplete/Sounds/surface.bfl");
    // Mixed-case sections, duplicate old values, CRLF, comments and unrelated
    // settings must survive replacing the remembered folder.
    Write(ini, "; keep this comment\r\n[PATHS]\r\ndata = missing\r\n"
               "[video]\r\nfov = 91\r\n[paths]\r\ndata = also-missing\r\n");
    const PlatformTestDialogs mock{OpenFolder, MessageBox};
    Platform_SetTestDialogs(&mock);
    folders = {(root / "incomplete").u8string(), game.u8string()};
    Check(Start(user), "select valid folder after incomplete folder");
    Check(dialogs == 2 && messages.size() == 2, "retry incomplete installation");
    Check(messages.back().find("FrontEnd/common.bfl") != std::string::npos &&
          messages.back().find("Sounds/surface.bfl") != std::string::npos, "list missing archives");
    Check(std::string(Platform_GetDataDir()) == game.u8string() + "/", "copy UTF-8 callback path");
    Check(Platform_GetSettingInt("video.fov", 0) == 91, "preserve unrelated settings");
    const std::string archivePath = std::string(CInstallInfo::GetBigFilesDir()) + "\\common.bfl";
    SysFile *archive = Sys_OpenFile(archivePath.c_str(), SYS_FILE_READ);

    char archiveBytes[64]{};
    Check(Sys_ReadFile(archive, archiveBytes, sizeof(archiveBytes)) == 22 &&
          std::string(archiveBytes) == "synthetic main archive", "read selected game files");
    Sys_CloseFile(archive);
    SysFile *save = Sys_OpenFile("gamesave\\setup-test.dat", SYS_FILE_WRITE);
    Check(save != nullptr && Sys_WriteFile(save, "test", 4) == 4, "write saves under UTF-8 user directory");
    Sys_CloseFile(save);
    const std::string saved = Read(ini);
    Check(saved.find("; keep this comment") != std::string::npos &&
          saved.find("data = " + game.u8string()) != std::string::npos &&
          saved.find("also-missing") == std::string::npos, "persist path without stale overrides");
    Platform_Shutdown();

    Check(Start(user), "load remembered folder on next launch");
    Check(dialogs == 2 && Read(ini) == saved, "next launch opens no dialogs or rewrites");
    Check(Platform_GetSettingInt("video.fov", 0) == 91, "reload preserved configuration");
    Platform_Shutdown();

    Check(Start(root / "explicit-user", game.u8string()), "explicit --data skips GUI");
    Check(dialogs == 2, "explicit data needs no selector");
    // Alt+Enter remembers the window mode: the default line changes in place.
    Check(Sys_SetOption("video.fullscreen", 0) && Sys_GetOption("video.fullscreen", 1) == 0 &&
          Sys_SetOption("Extra.Value", 3), "save options");
    const std::string options = Read(root / "explicit-user" / "opencmr2.ini");
    Check(options.find("fullscreen = 1") == std::string::npos &&
          options.find("; 1 = fullscreen") < options.find("fullscreen = 0") &&
          options.find("fullscreen = 0") < options.find("[net]") &&
          options.find("\n[extra]\nvalue = 3\n") != std::string::npos, "options saved in place");
    Platform_Shutdown();
    Check(!Start(root / "invalid-user", (root / "incomplete").u8string()), "invalid explicit data fails");
    Check(!Platform_WasSetupCanceled(), "invalid explicit data is an error");
    Check(dialogs == 2, "invalid --data does not wait for interaction");

    fs::rename(game, root / "moved-game");
    folders = {""};
    Check(!Start(user), "cancel when remembered folder has moved");
    Check(Platform_WasSetupCanceled(), "cancel is a clean exit");
    Check(Read(ini) == saved, "cancel leaves saved settings intact");
    fs::rename(root / "moved-game", root / "Data");
    Check(Start(root / "data-folder-user"), "automatically find Data folder beside the executable");
    Check(dialogs == 3, "Data folder needs no selector");
    Check(!Platform_WasSetupCanceled(), "new launch resets cancellation state");
    Platform_Shutdown();

    fs::rename(root / "Data", root / "moved-game");
    dialogError = exitOnWarning = true;
    Check(!Start(root / "dialog-error-user"), "folder selector failure returns to setup");
    Check(messages.back().find("No desktop folder selector available") != std::string::npos,
          "capture error from callback thread");
    dialogError = false;
    const fs::path blockedUser = root / "blocked-user";
    Write(blockedUser / "opencmr2.ini", "[video]\nfov = 85\n");
    fs::create_directory(blockedUser / "opencmr2.ini.tmp");
    folders = {(root / "moved-game").u8string()};
    Check(!Start(blockedUser), "settings write failure returns to setup");
    Check(messages.back().find("could not be saved") != std::string::npos &&
          Read(blockedUser / "opencmr2.ini") == "[video]\nfov = 85\n", "failed save preserves original INI");
    exitOnWarning = false;
    const fs::path movedGame = root / "moved-game";
    fs::create_directories(movedGame / "GAME/Tracks/Finland/1");
    for (const char *inside : {"GAME", "GAME/Bigfiles", "GAME/Tracks/Finland/1", "frontend", "Sounds"}) {
        folders = {(movedGame / inside).u8string()};
        const fs::path smartUser = root / "inside-user";
        fs::remove_all(smartUser);
        Check(Start(smartUser), "select a folder inside the installation");
        Check(std::string(Platform_GetDataDir()) == movedGame.u8string() + "/" &&
              Read(smartUser / "opencmr2.ini").find("data = " + movedGame.u8string()) != std::string::npos,
              "save the installation root rather than the chosen subfolder");
        Platform_Shutdown();
    }

    const fs::path collection = root / "collection";
    const fs::path nestedGame = collection / "download" / "CMR2" / "Data";
    fs::create_directories(nestedGame.parent_path());
    fs::rename(movedGame, nestedGame);
    folders = {collection.u8string()};
    Check(Start(root / "parent-user"), "find installation three levels below selected folder");
    Check(std::string(Platform_GetDataDir()) == nestedGame.u8string() + "/", "persist the discovered nested root");
    Platform_Shutdown();

    const fs::path secondGame = collection / "another-copy";
    fs::copy(nestedGame, secondGame, fs::copy_options::recursive);
    folders = {collection.u8string(), (nestedGame / "GAME").u8string()};
    const size_t beforeAmbiguous = messages.size();
    Check(Start(root / "ambiguous-user"), "ask again when several installations are found");
    Check(messages.size() == beforeAmbiguous + 2 &&
          messages.back().find("More than one") != std::string::npos &&
          std::string(Platform_GetDataDir()) == nestedGame.u8string() + "/", "do not choose a copy arbitrarily");
    Platform_Shutdown();

    // A cyclic symlink must not make a broad-folder search loop. Creating
    // symlinks may be disallowed on Windows, so also test the non-link path.
    std::error_code linkError;
    const fs::path noGame = root / "no-game";
    fs::create_directories(noGame / "child");
    fs::create_directory_symlink(noGame, noGame / "child/loop", linkError);
    folders = {noGame.u8string(), nestedGame.u8string()};
    Check(Start(root / "cycle-user"), "reject empty folders and tolerate symlink cycles");
    Platform_Shutdown();
    if (!linkError)
        Check(SDL_RemovePath((noGame / "child/loop").u8string().c_str()), "remove cyclic symlink fixture");
#ifdef __linux__
    // Without --user-dir, files that earlier versions kept one level deeper
    // (OpenCMR2/OpenCMR2) move up to the user directory.
    const fs::path xdg = root / "xdg";
    Write(xdg / "OpenCMR2/OpenCMR2/opencmr2.ini", "[paths]\ndata = " + nestedGame.u8string() + "\n");
    Write(xdg / "OpenCMR2/OpenCMR2/Configuration/GameInfo.rcf", "old save");
    // In the process environment: SDL_Quit drops SDL's copy between launches.
    setenv("XDG_DATA_HOME", xdg.u8string().c_str(), 1);
    setenv("SDL_VIDEODRIVER", "dummy", 1);
    char name[] = "game_data_setup";
    char *args[] = {name};
    Check(Platform_Init(1, args), "start from the default user directory");
    Check(std::string(Platform_GetUserDir()) == (xdg / "OpenCMR2").u8string() + "/" &&
          std::string(Platform_GetDataDir()) == nestedGame.u8string() + "/" &&
          Read(xdg / "OpenCMR2/Configuration/GameInfo.rcf") == "old save" &&
          !fs::exists(xdg / "OpenCMR2/OpenCMR2"), "move the old nested user directory");
    Platform_Shutdown();
    // That launch asked once about the applications menu (the mock says Add).
    const fs::path desktop = xdg / "applications/io.github.pablocpas.OpenCMR2.desktop";
    const fs::path icon = xdg / "icons/hicolor/256x256/apps/io.github.pablocpas.OpenCMR2.png";
    const std::string exe = fs::read_symlink("/proc/self/exe").u8string();
    const size_t asked = messages.size();
    Check(fs::exists(icon) && Read(desktop).find("\nExec=\"" + exe + "\"\n") != std::string::npos &&
          Read(desktop).find("\nIcon=" + icon.u8string() + "\n") != std::string::npos &&
          Read(xdg / "OpenCMR2/opencmr2.ini").find("menu_shortcut = 1") != std::string::npos,
          "add the menu entry when accepted");
    Check(Platform_Init(1, args), "start again with the menu entry");
    Check(messages.size() == asked, "ask about the menu entry only once");
    Platform_Shutdown();
    Write(xdg / "OpenCMR2/opencmr2.ini", "[paths]\ndata = " + nestedGame.u8string() + "\n[install]\nmenu_shortcut = 0\n");
    Check(Platform_Init(1, args), "start with the menu entry turned off");
    Check(!fs::exists(desktop) && !fs::exists(icon), "remove the menu entry");
    Platform_Shutdown();
    unsetenv("XDG_DATA_HOME");
#endif
    const int beforeExit = dialogs;
    exitSetup = true;
    Check(!Start(root / "exit-user"), "exit from welcome dialog");
    Check(dialogs == beforeExit, "exit does not open folder selector");
    Check(Platform_WasSetupCanceled(), "welcome exit is a clean exit");
    Platform_SetTestDialogs(nullptr);
    fs::current_path(previous);
    fs::remove_all(root);
    puts("game data setup: retry, UTF-8 paths, persistence, explicit data, cancel, Data folder and folder discovery passed");
}

```

`tests/gamepad_layout.cpp`:

```cpp
// Gamepads reach the game as DirectInput showed an Xbox controller, and
// triggers and pedals as DirectInput wheels report pedals: the maximum when
// released, the minimum when pressed fully (input_sdl.cpp). Uses SDL virtual
// devices, so no hardware or display is needed. The game window never has the
// keyboard focus here, as under gamescope: controllers must still be read.

#include "port/types.h"
#include "port/input.h"
#include "Input.h"
#include "Menu.h"

#include <SDL3/SDL.h>

#include <cstdio>
#include <cstring>
#include <initializer_list>

extern void Input_TranslatePedalsToMenuKeys();
extern void Input_MergeAssignedJoystickButtons(int slot, DeviceInfo *out);
extern void Input_RescanChangedJoysticks();
extern unsigned short Input_GetAssignedController();

namespace {

int s_failures;

void Check(bool ok, const char *what)
{
    if (!ok) {
        fprintf(stderr, "FAIL: %s\n", what);
        s_failures++;
    }
}

const LONG kRange = 1000;   // the game sets -range..range on each axis it uses

InputJoystickState Read(InputDevice *device)
{
    InputJoystickState state;
    Check(Input_ReadJoystick(device, &state) != FALSE, "joystick reads");
    return state;
}

unsigned MenuInput(DeviceInfo *pad)
{
    CInput::UpdateDevice(int(pad - CInput::m_availableDevices));
    Input_TranslatePedalsToMenuKeys();
    DeviceInfo keyboard{};
    Input_MergeAssignedJoystickButtons(0, &keyboard);
    return keyboard.field_0x8;
}

void CheckMenuNavigation(SDL_Joystick *virt, DeviceInfo *pad)
{
    for (int i = 0; i < SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_COUNT; ++i)
        SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, i, i >= SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER ? SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN : 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_COUNT; ++i)
        SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(virt, i, false);
    CInput::m_unk0x005168f4[0] = 2;
    Check((MenuInput(pad) & 0xf) == 0, "centred gamepad does not navigate");

    const struct { SDL_GamepadAxis axis; Sint16 value; unsigned direction; } stick[] = {
        {SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN, 4},
        {SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MAX, 8},
        {SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTX, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN, 1},
        {SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTX, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MAX, 2},
    };
    for (const auto &move : stick) {
        SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, move.axis, move.value);
        Check((MenuInput(pad) & 0xf) == move.direction, "left stick navigates menus in every direction");
        SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, move.axis, 0);
        MenuInput(pad);
    }
    const struct { SDL_GamepadButton button; unsigned direction; } dpad[] = {
        {SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_UP, 4}, {SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_DOWN, 8},
        {SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_LEFT, 1}, {SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_RIGHT, 2},
    };
    for (const auto &move : dpad) {
        SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(virt, move.button, true);
        Check((MenuInput(pad) & 0xf) == move.direction, "D-pad navigates menus in every direction");
        SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(virt, move.button, false);
        MenuInput(pad);
    }

    Menu menu{};
    Menu_Init(&menu, nullptr, 0, 0, nullptr, nullptr, 1, 1, 1);
    for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i)
        Menu_AddItemType1(&menu, nullptr, -1, nullptr, short(i));
    Menu_SetInputStateFlag(0); // no audio resources in this test
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN);
    Menu_Update(&menu, MenuInput(pad));
    Check(menu.cursor == 0, "stick input moves the real menu cursor up");
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY, 0);
    MenuInput(pad);
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_DOWN, true);
    Menu_Update(&menu, MenuInput(pad));
    Check(menu.cursor == 1, "D-pad input moves the real menu cursor down");
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_DOWN, false);
    MenuInput(pad);

    for (SDL_GamepadAxis trigger : {SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER}) {
        SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, trigger, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MAX);
        Check((MenuInput(pad) & 0xf) == 0, "a trigger does not navigate menus");
        SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN);
        Check((MenuInput(pad) & 0xf) == 4, "held trigger does not swallow stick navigation");
        SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTY, 0);
        SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, trigger, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN);
        Check((MenuInput(pad) & 0xf) == 0, "releasing a trigger does not navigate menus");
    }
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MAX);
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MAX);
    Check((MenuInput(pad) & 0xf) == 0, "both triggers do not navigate menus");
    Check(pad->joystick.bindings[2].field_0xc < -39321 && pad->joystick.bindings[5].field_0xc < -39321,
          "menu polling preserves both driving pedals");
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN);
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN);
    MenuInput(pad);
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH, true);
    Check((MenuInput(pad) & 0x30) == 0x10, "A confirms in menus");
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH, false);
    MenuInput(pad);
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_EAST, true);
    Check((MenuInput(pad) & 0x30) == 0x20, "B goes back in menus");
}

void CheckWheelMenuPedals(InputDevice *wheel, DeviceInfo *info)
{
    // A raw wheel keeps the original pedal navigation. Use the game's
    // polled axis values to exercise press/release latching deterministically.
    CInput::m_unk0x0059f6b0[info->field_0x18] = wheel;
    ControllerData &slot = CInput::m_controllerInfo[2];
    slot.field_0x2d8[2] = 2;
    slot.field_0x2d8[3] = 1;
    info->joystick.bindings[2].field_0xc = -0x10000;
    info->joystick.bindings[1].field_0xc = 0x10000;
    info->field_0x8 = 0x10;
    Input_TranslatePedalsToMenuKeys();
    Check(info->field_0x8 == 0x14, "wheel throttle navigates and preserves confirm");
    Input_TranslatePedalsToMenuKeys();
    Check(info->field_0x8 == 0x10, "held wheel pedal is latched once");
    info->joystick.bindings[2].field_0xc = 0x10000;
    info->joystick.bindings[1].field_0xc = -0x10000;
    Input_TranslatePedalsToMenuKeys();
    Check(info->field_0x8 == 0x18, "wheel brake navigates in the opposite direction");
    info->joystick.bindings[1].field_0xc = 0x10000;
    Input_TranslatePedalsToMenuKeys();
    Check(info->field_0x8 == 0x10, "released wheel pedals do not navigate");
    CInput::m_unk0x0059f6b0[info->field_0x18] = nullptr;
}

} // namespace

int main()
{
    SDL_SetHint(SDL_HINT_VIDEO_DRIVER, "dummy");
    if (!SDL_Init(SDL_INIT_VIDEO | SDL_INIT_JOYSTICK | SDL_INIT_GAMEPAD)) {
        fprintf(stderr, "SDL_Init: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
        return 1;
    }
    SDL_Window *window = SDL_CreateWindow("unfocused", 64, 64, SDL_WINDOW_HIDDEN);
    Check(window != NULL && SDL_GetKeyboardFocus() == NULL, "a game window without the keyboard focus");
    // An Xbox 360 controller: SDL knows its layout, as for a real one.
    SDL_VirtualJoystickDesc desc;
    SDL_INIT_INTERFACE(&desc);
    desc.type = SDL_JOYSTICK_TYPE_GAMEPAD;
    desc.vendor_id = 0x045e;
    desc.product_id = 0x028e;
    desc.naxes = SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_COUNT;
    desc.nbuttons = SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_COUNT;
    desc.name = "Virtual Xbox 360 Controller";
    SDL_JoystickID id = SDL_AttachVirtualJoystick(&desc);
    SDL_Joystick *virt = SDL_OpenJoystick(id);
    if (virt == NULL) {
        fprintf(stderr, "virtual joystick: %s\n", SDL_GetError());
        return 1;
    }
    // Released triggers rest at their minimum, as on real controllers.
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN);
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN);
    SDL_UpdateJoysticks();

    Check(Input_GetJoystickCount() == 1, "one joystick");
    Check(Input_JoysticksChanged() != FALSE, "a joystick not opened yet is a change");
    InputDevice *device = Input_OpenJoystick(0);
    if (device == NULL) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Input_OpenJoystick failed\n");
        return 1;
    }
    Check(Input_JoysticksChanged() == FALSE, "no change once every joystick is open");
    InputCaps caps;
    Input_GetCaps(device, &caps);
    Check(caps.axes == 6 && caps.buttons == 10 && caps.povs == 1, "Xbox layout: 6 axes, 10 buttons, 1 POV");
    for (DWORD offset = 0; offset < 6 * 4; offset += 4)
        Input_SetAxisRange(device, offset, -kRange, kRange);

    Check(Input_IsGamepad(device) != FALSE, "recognised as a gamepad");
    InputJoystickState s = Read(device);
    Check(s.lZ == kRange && s.lRz == kRange, "released triggers read as released pedals");
    Check(s.lX == 0 && s.lY == 0 && s.lRx == 0 && s.lRy == 0, "sticks are centred");
    Check(s.rgdwPOV[0] == INPUT_POV_CENTERED, "D-pad centred");

    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MAX);
    SDL_UpdateJoysticks();
    s = Read(device);
    Check(s.lRz == -kRange && s.lZ == kRange, "right trigger moves Rz alone");

    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFT_TRIGGER, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MAX);
    SDL_UpdateJoysticks();
    s = Read(device);
    Check(s.lZ == -kRange && s.lRz == -kRange, "both triggers held at once");

    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHT_TRIGGER, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN);
    SDL_UpdateJoysticks();
    s = Read(device);
    Check(s.lRz == kRange && s.lZ == -kRange, "released right trigger is released again");

    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_LEFTX, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN);
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_AXIS_RIGHTY, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MAX);
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_SOUTH, true);
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_START, true);
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualButton(virt, SDL_GAMEPAD_BUTTON_DPAD_RIGHT, true);
    SDL_UpdateJoysticks();
    s = Read(device);
    Check(s.lX == -kRange && s.lRy == kRange, "left stick X and right stick Y");
    Check(s.rgbButtons[0] == 0x80 && s.rgbButtons[7] == 0x80 && s.rgbButtons[1] == 0, "A is button 0, Start button 7");
    Check(s.rgdwPOV[0] == 9000, "D-pad right is POV 90 degrees");

    char name[64];
    Check(Input_GetObjectName(device, 2 * 4, name, sizeof(name)) && strcmp(name, "Z Axis") == 0, "Z axis named");

    // The game's controller table has room for four devices.
    SDL_VirtualJoystickDesc extra;
    SDL_INIT_INTERFACE(&extra);
    extra.naxes = 2;
    extra.nbuttons = 4;
    extra.name = "Virtual Extra Joystick";
    SDL_JoystickID extras[4];
    for (SDL_JoystickID &extraId : extras)
        extraId = SDL_AttachVirtualJoystick(&extra);
    Check(Input_JoysticksChanged() != FALSE, "a connected joystick is a change");
    Check(Input_GetJoystickCount() == 4, "at most four joysticks reach the game");
    for (SDL_JoystickID extraId : extras)
        SDL_DetachVirtualJoystick(extraId);
    Check(Input_JoysticksChanged() == FALSE, "disconnecting them restores the opened set");
    Input_CloseDevice(device);
    Check(Input_JoysticksChanged() != FALSE, "a connected joystick that is not open is a change");

    // The game's own detection gives a gamepad throttle on the right trigger
    // (Rz, axis 5) and brake on the left (Z, axis 2), as separate pedals.
    // As at startup, device slots 0 and 1 are reserved for keyboards.
    CInput::m_unk0x0059f8cc.field_0x0 = 2;
    CInput::GetAttachedJoysticks();
    DeviceInfo *pad = NULL;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8 && pad == NULL; i++)
        if (CInput::m_availableDevices[i].field_0x0 == 3)
            pad = &CInput::m_availableDevices[i];
    Check(pad != NULL, "the game set up the gamepad");
    if (pad != NULL) {
        CInput::InitDetectedControllerSlot(pad, 2);
        const ControllerData &slot = CInput::m_controllerInfo[2];
        Check(slot.field_0x210[0].field_0x0 != 0 && slot.field_0x2d8[0] == 0, "default steering on the left stick");
        Check(slot.field_0x210[2].field_0x0 != 0 && slot.field_0x2d8[2] == 5, "default throttle on the right trigger");
        Check(slot.field_0x210[3].field_0x0 != 0 && slot.field_0x2d8[3] == 2, "default brake on the left trigger");
        CheckMenuNavigation(virt, pad);
        Input_CloseDevice(CInput::m_unk0x0059f6b0[pad->field_0x18]);
        CInput::m_unk0x0059f6b0[pad->field_0x18] = NULL;
    }

    SDL_CloseJoystick(virt);
    SDL_DetachVirtualJoystick(id);

    // A wheel whose pedal axis rests at its minimum, as some report it.
    SDL_INIT_INTERFACE(&desc);
    desc.type = SDL_JOYSTICK_TYPE_WHEEL;
    desc.naxes = 3;
    desc.name = "Virtual Wheel";
    id = SDL_AttachVirtualJoystick(&desc);
    virt = SDL_OpenJoystick(id);
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, 2, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MIN);
    SDL_UpdateJoysticks();
    device = Input_OpenJoystick(0);
    if (device == NULL) {
        fprintf(stderr, "Input_OpenJoystick failed for the wheel\n");
        return 1;
    }
    Check(Input_IsGamepad(device) == FALSE, "a wheel is not a gamepad");
    for (DWORD offset = 0; offset < 3 * 4; offset += 4)
        Input_SetAxisRange(device, offset, -kRange, kRange);
    s = Read(device);
    Check(s.lZ == kRange && s.lX == 0, "released pedal reads released, wheel centred");
    SDL_SetJoystickVirtualAxis(virt, 2, SDL_JOYSTICK_AXIS_MAX);
    SDL_UpdateJoysticks();
    s = Read(device);
    Check(s.lZ == -kRange, "pressed pedal reads pressed");
    if (pad != nullptr)
        CheckWheelMenuPedals(device, pad);
    Input_CloseDevice(device);
    SDL_CloseJoystick(virt);
    SDL_DetachVirtualJoystick(id);

    // A wheel connected after startup, or one that reconnects as it leaves
    // its generic USB mode, is listed once the controls menu is entered.
    CInput::RebuildAvailableInputDevices();
    CInput::RefreshControllerConfigurations();
    const unsigned short before = Input_GetAssignedController();
    desc.name = "Virtual T150";
    desc.nbuttons = 13;
    id = SDL_AttachVirtualJoystick(&desc);
    Input_RescanChangedJoysticks();
    Check(Input_GetAssignedController() == before + 1 &&
          strcmp(CInput::m_controllerInfo[before].name, "Virtual T150") == 0,
          "a wheel connected later is listed in the controls menu");
    SDL_DetachVirtualJoystick(id);
    Input_RescanChangedJoysticks();
    Check(Input_GetAssignedController() == before && CInput::m_unk0x0059f6b0[0] == NULL,
          "a disconnected wheel is closed and no longer listed");
    CInput::DInputReleaseDevices();

    SDL_DestroyWindow(window);
    SDL_Quit();
    if (s_failures == 0)
        puts("gamepad layout: unfocused input, driving pedals, menus, wheels and hotplug passed");
    return s_failures == 0 ? 0 : 1;
}
```

`tests/headlight_collision.cpp`:

```cpp
#include "port/types.h"
#include "Car.h"
#include "CarLightState.h"
#include "Collision2D.h"
#include "high_address.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cstdint>

extern void Scene_InitFixedMathTables();
extern void StageObject_TestHeadlightGlowsAgainstCarBox(Car *, CollisionBox *);
#define REQUIRE(x) do { if (!(x)) { fprintf(stderr, "glow collision: line %d: %s\n", __LINE__, #x); return 1; } } while (0)

int main()
{
    Scene_InitFixedMathTables();
    // A high native centre pointer with a zero pArray exposes reading word
    // 0x25: on x64 that word is the upper half of pArray, not pVertex.
    FixVector *centre = (FixVector *)Test_AllocateHighAddress(2 * 1024 * 1024);
    REQUIRE(centre);
    if (sizeof(void *) == 8) REQUIRE((uintptr_t)centre > UINT32_MAX);
    CollisionBox box = {};
    box.pVertex = centre;
    box.top = 2 * 65536;
    box.bottom = -2 * 65536;
    box.halfWidth = box.halfLength = 65536;
    box.axisA.x = box.axisB.z = 65536;
    Car car = {};
    memset(g_carHeadlightGlowRecords, 0, sizeof(g_carHeadlightGlowRecords));
    auto &glow = g_carHeadlightGlowRecords[0];
    glow.active = 1;
    glow.car = 1;
    glow.position.x = 101 * 65536;
    Car original = car;
    StageObject_TestHeadlightGlowsAgainstCarBox(&car, &box);
    REQUIRE(glow.active && !memcmp(&car, &original, sizeof(car)));
    glow.position.x = 2 * 65536;
    StageObject_TestHeadlightGlowsAgainstCarBox(&car, &box);
    REQUIRE(glow.active && !memcmp(&car, &original, sizeof(car)));
    glow.car = car.index;
    glow.position.x = 0;
    StageObject_TestHeadlightGlowsAgainstCarBox(&car, &box);
    REQUIRE(glow.active && !memcmp(&car, &original, sizeof(car)));
    memset(g_carHeadlightGlowRecords, 0, sizeof(g_carHeadlightGlowRecords));
    Test_FreeHighAddress(centre);
    puts("glow collision: native centre pointer, distant/axis rejection and owner filter passed");
    return 0;
}
```

`tests/high_address.c`:

```c
// Separate SDK translation unit: the game headers replace Win32 type names.
#include "high_address.h"
#include <stdlib.h>
#if defined(_WIN64)
#include <windows.h>
#endif

void *Test_AllocateHighAddress(size_t size)
{
#if defined(_WIN64)
    // Wine may keep even large malloc blocks below 4 GB. These regressions
    // must exercise a real pointer whose upper 32 bits are nonzero.
    for (size_t address = 0x100000000ULL; address < 0x1000000000ULL; address += 0x100000000ULL) {
        void *memory = VirtualAlloc((void *)address, size, MEM_RESERVE | MEM_COMMIT, PAGE_READWRITE);
        if (memory) return memory;
    }
    return NULL;
#else
    return calloc(1, size);
#endif
}

void Test_FreeHighAddress(void *memory)
{
#if defined(_WIN64)
    VirtualFree(memory, 0, MEM_RELEASE);
#else
    free(memory);
#endif
}
```

`tests/lan_game.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Two independent game processes: LAN discovery, join, ready and stage load.

Accepts native probes or the Wine wrapper used by physics_parity.py. Both
processes use isolated profiles and the same real UDP protocol as LAN play.
"""
import argparse
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile


def verify(host_probe, guest_probe, data, output):
    processes = []
    logs = []
    # Reserve two distinct ports until profiles are written.
    sockets = [socket.socket(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_DGRAM) for _ in range(2)]
    try:
        for s in sockets:
            s.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        host_port, guest_port = [s.getsockname()[1] for s in sockets]
        for role, port, probe in [('host', host_port, host_probe), ('guest', guest_port, guest_probe)]:
            run = output / role
            user = run / 'user'
            user.mkdir(parents=True)
            (user / 'opencmr2.ini').write_text(
                f'[net]\nport={port}\npeers=127.0.0.1:{host_port}\nbroadcast=0\ntailscale=off\n')
            env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith('OPENCMR2_PROBE_')}
            browser = 1 if role == 'host' else 0
            env.update(OPENCMR2_HEADLESS='1', SDL_VIDEODRIVER='dummy', SDL_AUDIODRIVER='dummy',
                       XDG_DATA_HOME=str(user), OPENCMR2_PROBE_LAN_ROLE=role,
                       OPENCMR2_PROBE_CURSORS=f'0:3,33:2,60:0,53:{browser},61:6,19:2,62:3',
                       OPENCMR2_PROBE_EXPECT_CARS='2', OPENCMR2_PROBE_EXPECT_MODE='8',
                       OPENCMR2_PROBE_SESSION_NAME='LAN TEST')
            logs.append((run / 'run.log').open('w'))
            sockets[len(processes)].close()
            processes.append(subprocess.Popen(
                [str(probe), str(data), str(run / 'trace.jsonl'), '30', '500'],
                env=env, stdout=logs[-1], stderr=subprocess.STDOUT))
        for role, process in zip(('host', 'guest'), processes):
            code = process.wait(timeout=60)
            if code:
                raise RuntimeError(f'{role} failed ({code}): {output / role / "run.log"}')
        report = {}
        for role in ('host', 'guest'):
            records = [json.loads(line) for line in (output / role / 'trace.jsonl').read_text().splitlines()]
            if len(records) != 500 or records[-1]['driving_tick'] <= 0:
                raise ValueError(f'{role}: no complete two-player race')
            remote_positions = {tuple(car['position']) for record in records if record['state'] == 8
                                for car in record['cars'] if car['id'] == 1}
            if len(remote_positions) < 50:
                raise ValueError(f'{role}: remote car did not advance')
            report[role] = {'ticks': len(records), 'driving_ticks': records[-1]['driving_tick'],
                            'distinct_remote_positions': len(remote_positions)}
        if 'probe: LAN guest ready' not in (output / 'host/run.log').read_text():
            raise ValueError('host started without receiving guest readiness')
        (output / 'acceptance.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + '\n')
        print('LAN game: host and guest joined and drove 500 ticks with two cars')
    finally:
        for process in processes:
            if process.poll() is None:
                process.kill()
            process.wait()
        for log in logs:
            log.close()
        for s in sockets:
            s.close()


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument('--host-probe', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--guest-probe', type=Path)
    parser.add_argument('--data', type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--output', type=Path)
    args = parser.parse_args()
    host = args.host_probe.resolve()
    guest = (args.guest_probe or args.host_probe).resolve()
    if args.output:
        args.output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
        verify(host, guest, args.data.resolve(), args.output.resolve())
    else:
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opencmr2-lan-') as directory:
            verify(host, guest, args.data.resolve(), Path(directory))


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

```

`tests/math_tables.cpp`:

```cpp
// Compare the actual startup tables with a dump from original + SilentPatch.
#include "port/types.h"
#include "FixedPoint.h"
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>

extern void Scene_InitFixedMathTables();
extern short g_acosTable[4096];

template <class T> static void Compare(FILE *file, const char *name, const T *table, unsigned count) {
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
        T expected;
        if (fread(&expected, sizeof(expected), 1, file) != 1) {
            fprintf(stderr, "math tables: truncated reference\n"); exit(1);
        }
        if (table[i] != expected) {
            fprintf(stderr, "%s[%u]: original %lld, port %lld\n", name, i,
                    (long long)expected, (long long)table[i]); exit(1);
        }
    }
}

int main(int argc, char **argv) {
    if (argc != 2) return 2;
    FILE *file = fopen(argv[1], "rb");
    if (!file) { perror(argv[1]); return 2; }
    Scene_InitFixedMathTables();
    Compare(file, "sqrt", g_sqrtTable, 4096);
    Compare(file, "sin", g_sinTable, 4096);
    Compare(file, "acos", g_acosTable, 4096);
    Compare(file, "atan", g_atanTable, 512);
    Compare(file, "tan", g_tanTable, 4096);
    if (fgetc(file) != EOF || ferror(file)) return 1;
    fclose(file);
    puts("math tables: all 16,896 entries identical to original + SilentPatch");
}
```

```cpp
    Movie_DecodeFrame(movie); Movie_DecodeFrame(movie);
    Check(queues == 1 && starts == 0 && queued.size() == 960, "duplicate decode/audio start");

        for (int x = 0; x < 9; ++x) Check(texture->pixels[y * texture->pitch + x * 4] == 76, "texture pixels");
        for (int x = 36; x < texture->pitch; ++x) Check(texture->pixels[y * texture->pitch + x] == 0xab, "texture pitch padding");
    }

    Check(starts == 1, "audio starts with first presentation");
    Check(savedStates == 0, "movie balances render-state preservation");
    Check(stretchedPresents == 1 && drawn[0].sx == 0 && drawn[0].sy == 0 &&
          drawn[3].sx == 1920 && drawn[3].sy == 1080 && drawn[3].tu == 1 && drawn[3].tv == 1,
          "movie stretches to the requested rectangle");
    PresentationRect rect = GetPresentationRect(640, 480, 1920, 1080, true);
    Check(rect.x == 0 && rect.y == 0 && rect.width == 1920 && rect.height == 1080,
          "movie fills widescreen output with a 4:3 back buffer");
    rect = GetPresentationRect(640, 480, 1920, 1080, false);
    Check(rect.x == 240 && rect.y == 0 && rect.width == 1440 && rect.height == 1080,
          "game presentation after movies retains aspect ratio");
    rect = GetPresentationRect(640, 480, 900, 1600, true);
    Check(rect.x == 0 && rect.y == 0 && rect.width == 900 && rect.height == 1600,
          "movie fills resized portrait window");
    Movie_NextFrame(movie);
    Check(Movie_GetFrameNumber(movie) == 2 && Movie_GetFrameCount(movie) == 2, "last frame accessible");
    Check(Movie_Wait(movie), "fractional frame pacing");
    ticks += 33; // Includes millisecond clock wrap.
    Check(!Movie_Wait(movie), "wrapped playback clock");
    Movie_DecodeFrame(movie); Movie_Present(movie, 0, 0, 640, 480);
    Check(queues == 2 && starts == 1, "second frame audio/clock continuity");
    Movie_NextFrame(movie); ticks += 33;
    Check(Movie_GetFrameNumber(movie) > Movie_GetFrameCount(movie) && !Movie_Wait(movie), "movie completion");
    Movie_Close(movie);
    Check(files == 0 && textures == 0 && streams == 0, "close discards movie resources/audio");
    movie = Movie_Open("test.bik", 7); Movie_DecodeFrame(movie); Movie_Close(movie);
    Check(files == 0 && textures == 0 && streams == 0, "skip releases queued sound");
    uint32_t second = uint32_t(data[60]) | uint32_t(data[61]) << 8 |
                      uint32_t(data[62]) << 16 | uint32_t(data[63]) << 24;
    Put32(data, second & ~1u, 0xffffffff);
    movie = Movie_Open("test.bik", 7);
    Movie_DecodeFrame(movie); Movie_Present(movie, 0, 0, 640, 480); Movie_NextFrame(movie);
    Movie_DecodeFrame(movie);
    Check(Movie_GetFrameNumber(movie) > Movie_GetFrameCount(movie) && !Movie_Wait(movie) && streams == 0,
          "corrupt packet must stop audio/playback immediately");
    Movie_Close(movie);
    failTexture = true;
    Check(!Movie_Open("test.bik", 7) && files == 0 && textures == 0 && streams == 0, "texture failure cleanup");
    data[0] = 0;
    Check(!Movie_Open("test.bik", 7) && files == 0, "invalid header cleanup");
    Movie_Close(nullptr);
    std::puts("Movie texture, audio queue, pacing, final frame and cleanup tests passed");
}
```

```cpp
struct CaptureExecutor : GfxExecutor {
    bool SetVideoMode(int, int, bool) override { return true; }
    void SetFullscreen(bool) override {}
    void Execute(GfxFrame &frame, std::vector<GfxTexture *> &, GfxReadback &, bool, bool, bool stretch) override {
        stretched = stretch;
        for (const auto &command : frame.commands)
            if (command.type == GFX_CMD_DRAW)
                drawnState = frame.states[command.state];
    }
    void DestroyTexture(GfxTexture *) override {}
    void ReadTexture(GfxTexture *) override {}
};
GfxExecutor *Gfx_CreateGpuExecutor() { return new CaptureExecutor; }

int main()
{
    data = Container(8, 8, {Video(8, 8, 6, 81)});
    Check(Gfx_SetVideoMode(640, 480, FALSE), "renderer init");
    auto *menuTexture = Gfx_CreateTexture(8, 8, GFX_FORMAT_BGRA8, 1, 0);
    Gfx_SetTexture(0, menuTexture);
    Gfx_SetAlphaBlend(TRUE);
    Gfx_SetAlphaTest(TRUE);
    Gfx_SetSrcBlend(GFX_BLEND_SRCALPHA);
    Gfx_SetDestBlend(GFX_BLEND_INVSRCALPHA);
    Gfx_SetCullMode(GFX_CULL_CW);
    Gfx_SetStageColorOp(0, GFX_TOP_MODULATE);
    Gfx_SetStageAlphaOp(0, GFX_TOP_MODULATE);
    Gfx_SetStageColorOp(1, GFX_TOP_MODULATE);
    Gfx_SetStageAlphaOp(1, GFX_TOP_MODULATE);
    Movie *movie = Movie_Open("test.bik", -1);
    Check(movie != nullptr, "movie open");
    Movie_DecodeFrame(movie);
    for (int i = 0; i < 2; ++i) {
        Movie_Present(movie, 0, 0, 640, 480);
        Check(stretched && !drawnState.alphaBlend && !drawnState.alphaTest && !drawnState.depthTest &&
              drawnState.stages[0].texture != menuTexture, "movie pass uses its own state");
        // Draw the menu without resetting the cached state, exactly as at boot.
        GfxTLVertex vertices[3] = {};
        Gfx_DrawPrimitiveTL(GFX_TRIANGLELIST, vertices, 3);
        Gfx_Present(FALSE);
        Check(!stretched && drawnState.alphaBlend && drawnState.alphaTest && drawnState.depthTest &&
              drawnState.cull == GFX_CULL_CW && drawnState.srcBlend == GFX_BLEND_SRCALPHA &&
              drawnState.destBlend == GFX_BLEND_INVSRCALPHA, "menu transparency and depth survive movies");
        Check(drawnState.stages[0].texture == menuTexture &&
              drawnState.stages[0].colorOp == GFX_TOP_MODULATE && drawnState.stages[0].alphaOp == GFX_TOP_MODULATE &&
              drawnState.stages[1].colorOp == GFX_TOP_MODULATE && drawnState.stages[1].alphaOp == GFX_TOP_MODULATE &&
              drawnState.stages[0].address == GFX_ADDRESS_WRAP &&
              drawnState.stages[0].minFilter == GFX_FILTER_POINT && drawnState.stages[0].magFilter == GFX_FILTER_POINT,
              "menu texture stages and sampling survive movies");
    }
    Movie_Close(movie);
    Gfx_Shutdown();
    puts("movie render state: menu rendering survives movie presentation");
}
```

`tests/net_frontend.cpp`:

```cpp
// Real UDP notifications passed to the game's lobby handler. Receive writes
// native pointers into the caller's buffer; these are not 32-bit wire fields.
#include "port/types.h"
#include "net/net_session.h"
#include "GameInfo.h"
#include "NetPlayers.h"
#include "high_address.h"

#include <chrono>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <thread>

extern void FrontendNetwork_HandleJoinerMessage(NetPlayerID *, unsigned int *);
extern void OptionMenu_HandleItemNotification(unsigned int *, int *);
extern void NetRace_HandleDeviceNotification(DWORD *, int *);
extern NetSessionDesc g_networkSession;
extern void GameInfo_SetConfiguredGameMode(BYTE);
extern int GameInfo_GetSessionField398C();

static void Check(bool condition, const char *message)
{
    if (!condition) { fprintf(stderr, "net frontend: %s\n", message); exit(1); }
}

static void *buffer;
static void *Receive(net::Session &session, DWORD type)
{
    const auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(4);
    while (std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < end) {
        NetPlayerID from = 0, to = 0;
        DWORD size = 4096;
        const HRESULT hr = session.Receive(&from, &to, buffer, &size);
        Check(hr == NET_OK || hr == NET_ERR_NOMESSAGES, "receive failed");
        if (hr == NET_OK && from == NET_ID_SYSTEM && *(DWORD *)buffer == type)
            return buffer;
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
    }
    Check(false, "notification timed out");
    return nullptr;
}

static NetPlayer *Find(NetPlayerID id)
{
    for (auto &player : g_netPlayers)
        if ((player.flags & 0x80) && player.id == int(id)) return &player;
    return nullptr;
}

int main()
{
    buffer = Test_AllocateHighAddress(2 * 1024 * 1024);
    Check(buffer != nullptr, "allocate receive buffer");
    if (sizeof(void *) == 8)
        Check(uintptr_t(buffer) > UINT32_MAX, "receive buffer must be above 4 GB");
    net::Config config;
    config.port = 0;
    config.broadcast = false;
    net::Session host(config);
    Check(host.Start() == NET_OK, "start host");
    NetSessionDesc desc{};
    desc.dwSize = sizeof(desc);
    desc.guidApplication.bytes[0] = 42;
    desc.dwMaxPlayers = 8;
    desc.lpszSessionNameA = (char *)"LAN regression";
    desc.dwUser1 = 8;
    desc.dwUser3 = 3;
    Check(host.Open(&desc, NET_OPEN_CREATE) == NET_OK, "open host");
    NetName name{sizeof(NetName), 0, (char *)"host", (char *)"host"};
    NetPlayerInfo info{0, {0x83}, 123, 456};
    NetPlayerID hostId = 0, guestId = 0;
    Check(host.CreatePlayer(&hostId, &name, &info, sizeof(info)) == NET_OK, "create host player");
    config.peers.push_back("127.0.0.1:" + std::to_string(host.BoundPort()));
    net::Session guest(config);
    Check(guest.Start() == NET_OK, "start guest");
    bool found = false;
    const auto end = std::chrono::steady_clock::now() + std::chrono::seconds(4);
    while (!found && std::chrono::steady_clock::now() < end) {
        struct Search { NetSessionDesc *desc; bool *found; } search{&desc, &found};
        guest.EnumSessions(&desc.guidApplication, [](const NetSessionDesc *session, void *context) -> BOOL {
            auto &search = *(Search *)context;
            search.desc->guidInstance = session->guidInstance;
            *search.found = true;
            return FALSE;
        }, &search);
        std::this_thread::sleep_for(std::chrono::milliseconds(5));
    }
    Check(found && guest.Open(&desc, NET_OPEN_JOIN) == NET_OK, "discover and join host");
    name.lpszShortNameA = name.lpszLongNameA = (char *)"guest";
    Check(guest.CreatePlayer(&guestId, &name, &info, sizeof(info)) == NET_OK, "create guest player");

    // The actual game state is updated, without a second game singleton:
    // outgoing descriptions are covered by net_session's transport tests.
    GameInfo_SetConfiguredGameMode(8);
    auto *create = (NetMsgCreatePlayer *)Receive(host, NET_SYS_CREATEPLAYER);
    Check(create->dpId == guestId && create->dwDataSize == sizeof(info), "create payload");
    FrontendNetwork_HandleJoinerMessage(nullptr, (unsigned int *)create);
    Check(Find(guestId) && Find(guestId)->flags == info.flags && Find(guestId)->field_0x8 == 123,
          "host lobby must retain guest description");
    puts("net frontend: guest created"); fflush(stdout);

    info.flags = 0x89;
    info.field_0x8 = 789;
    Check(guest.SetPlayerData(guestId, &info, sizeof(info)) == NET_OK, "update guest data");
    FrontendNetwork_HandleJoinerMessage(nullptr, (unsigned int *)Receive(host, NET_SYS_SETPLAYERDATA));
    Check(Find(guestId) && Find(guestId)->flags == info.flags && Find(guestId)->field_0x8 == 789,
          "host lobby must update guest description");
    for (DWORD size : {DWORD(0), DWORD(4)}) {
        Check(guest.SetPlayerData(guestId, &info, size) == NET_OK, "publish incomplete player data");
        FrontendNetwork_HandleJoinerMessage(nullptr, (unsigned int *)Receive(host, NET_SYS_SETPLAYERDATA));
        Check(Find(guestId) && Find(guestId)->field_0x8 == 789, "incomplete data must not overwrite player");
    }

    desc.dwUser1 = 10;
    desc.dwUser3 = 7;
    Check(host.SetSessionDesc(&desc) == NET_OK, "update host options");
    FrontendNetwork_HandleJoinerMessage(nullptr, (unsigned int *)Receive(guest, NET_SYS_SETSESSIONDESC));
    Check(CGameInfo::GetConfiguredGameMode() == 10 && GameInfo_GetSessionField398C() == 7 &&
          g_networkSession.dwMaxPlayers == 8 &&
          memcmp(&g_networkSession.guidInstance, &desc.guidInstance, sizeof(NetGuid)) == 0,
          "guest must read host options at native alignment");

    Check(guest.Close() == NET_OK, "guest leaves");
    auto *destroy = (NetMsgDestroyPlayer *)Receive(host, NET_SYS_DESTROYPLAYER);
    FrontendNetwork_HandleJoinerMessage(nullptr, (unsigned int *)destroy);
    Check(!Find(guestId), "lobby removes guest");
    for (int handler = 0; handler < 2; handler++) {
        DWORD from = 0;

        g_netPlayers[0].id = int(guestId);
        g_netPlayers[0].flags = 0x80;
        if (handler == 0)
            OptionMenu_HandleItemNotification((unsigned int *)&from, (int *)destroy);
        else
            NetRace_HandleDeviceNotification(&from, (int *)destroy);
        Check(!Find(guestId), "in-race/results handler removes guest");
    }
    // A player can initially have no custom data. Its later description
    // arrives as SETPLAYERDATA, so CREATEPLAYER must not dereference null.
    Check(guest.Open(&desc, NET_OPEN_JOIN) == NET_OK, "rejoin host");
    Check(guest.CreatePlayer(&guestId, &name, nullptr, 0) == NET_OK, "create player without data");
    FrontendNetwork_HandleJoinerMessage(nullptr, (unsigned int *)Receive(host, NET_SYS_CREATEPLAYER));
    Check(!Find(guestId), "empty create must wait for player description");
    Check(guest.SetPlayerData(guestId, &info, sizeof(info)) == NET_OK, "publish initial player description");
    FrontendNetwork_HandleJoinerMessage(nullptr, (unsigned int *)Receive(host, NET_SYS_SETPLAYERDATA));
    Check(Find(guestId) && Find(guestId)->field_0x8 == 789, "late description adds player");
    Test_FreeHighAddress(buffer);
    puts("net frontend: UDP join, player update, host options and departure passed");
}
```
